descriptions.en:
A warrior walks, alone in crowds
Companion to moon and mist and bat
With a vision grim the mind enshrouds
This fearsome, deathborne aristocrat.
descriptions.zh:
孤傲的战士，独行于族群
唯有月雾蝠，常伴其左右
眼神若冰霜，内心亦朦胧
化身为恐惧，死亡之贵族

descriptions.en: Move as the Eidolons and burn the ground coldly with footsteps of shimmering Void energy.
descriptions.zh: 像夜灵般移步，以闪烁的虚空能量，无情地践踏并焚烧地面。

descriptions.en: Your Warframe leaves crackling footprints in its wake.

descriptions.en: Expressing the martial finesse and skill of its master, the Daman Sugatra follows a rare Orokin design.
descriptions.zh: 遵循一个罕见的奥罗金设计来制作的达曼坠饰能展现出使用者的武术技巧与技术。

descriptions.en: Expressing the martial finesse and skill of its master, the Pazza Sugatra is based on a Corpus design.
descriptions.zh: 表现出使用者的武艺及技​​巧，巴沙坠饰基于 Corpus 的设计。

descriptions.en: Expressing the martial finesse and skill of its master, the Tantu Sugatra is based on a Grineer design.
descriptions.zh: 由Grineer 设计的坦图坠饰能展现出使用者的武术技巧与技术。

descriptions.en: Never stop fighting, never run out of ammo. Temple's signature machine pistol was modified by Albrecht Entrati to warp fired bullets back into the magazine when reloaded.
descriptions.zh: （英文：RIOT-848）弹药无穷无尽，战斗至死方休。Temple 的标志性连发手枪经过阿尔布雷希特·英择谛的改造，装填时，被消耗的子弹会重新回到弹匣中。

descriptions.en: Furis pistols equipped in each hand. Twice the Magazine Capacity and slightly faster Fire Rate, but Accuracy and Reload Speed are lowered.
descriptions.zh: （英文：AFURIS）双手各装备一把盗贼手枪，具有两倍的弹匣容量与稍快的射速，但精准度会下降，且换弹的速度增长。

descriptions.en: Engage your enemies with deadly speed. This weapon reloads even faster when its wielder sprints, faster still with Gauss.
descriptions.zh: （英文：ACCELTRA PRIME）以致命的速度与敌人交战。当使用者冲刺时，会有更快的装填速度，搭配 Gauss 使用时，速度还会更快。

descriptions.en: The gilded speargun of Styanax Prime shines like a beacon across the battlefield, invigorating allies and stunning enemies.
descriptions.zh: （英文：AFENTIS PRIME）Styanax Prime 的镀金标枪如同战场上的灯塔般闪耀，鼓舞盟友，震慑敌人。

descriptions.en: Vanquish chaos with dual firepower.
descriptions.zh: （英文：AFURIS PRIME）以双重火力征服混乱。

descriptions.en: A Bolto equipped in each hand. Twice the Magazine Capacity and slightly faster Fire Rate, but reload time is doubled and accuracy is lowered.
descriptions.zh: （英文：AKBOLTO）双手各装备一把螺钉手枪，具有两倍的弹匣容量与稍快的射速，但精准度会下降，且需两倍的换弹时间。

descriptions.en: Wield a golden pair of rocket launchers. Sprint to reload them faster. They reload fastest when wielded by Gauss.
descriptions.zh: （英文：AKARIUS PRIME）挥舞一对金色火箭发射器。冲刺时可以拥有更快的装填速度。搭配 Gauss 使用时，其装填速度更快。

descriptions.en: Gilded rails adorn these two vicious bolt launching pistols.
descriptions.zh: （英文：Akbolto Prime）镀金的导轨装饰着这对凶猛的钉枪。

descriptions.en: Used together, these Orokin pistols feed off each other, inflicting greater damage with an enhanced status chance for inducing elemental effects on targets.
descriptions.zh: （英文：AKBRONCO PRIME）同时使用这两把相辅相成的奥罗金手枪 ，以更高的元素触发几率，来对目标造成更大的伤害。

descriptions.en: Precision machined mirrored pistols. Primed and ready.
descriptions.zh: （英文：AKJAGARA PRIME）精密加工的镜像手枪。填装完毕并蓄势待发。

descriptions.en: Dual Lex pistols double the amount of high caliber lead you can throw at the enemy, but accuracy and reload time suffer.
descriptions.zh: （英文：AKLEX）以雷克斯双枪的两只大口径枪管朝敌人开火，但精准度和装填时间会受到负面影响。

descriptions.en: Savage the enemy with a Lex Prime in each hand.
descriptions.zh: （英文：AKLEX PRIME）双手各持一把雷克斯 Prime 猛攻敌人。

descriptions.en: Fill your fists with golden cannons of fury. This refined design unlocks quicker handling and higher critical chance.
descriptions.zh: （英文：AKMAGNUS PRIME）给你的拳中塞上这愤怒的金色教条。这种精良的设计可加快操作速度并提高暴击几率。

descriptions.en: The devastating power of the Soma rifle compacted into two elegant pistols.
descriptions.zh: （英文：AKSOMATI ）月神步枪的强大威力被凝聚在这对优雅的手枪当中。

descriptions.en: The elegant Aksomati precisely refined to this, their ultimate manifestation.
descriptions.zh: （英文：AKSOMATI PRIME）优雅的轻灵月神双枪精准定义了它们的终极表现。

descriptions.en: Stylish, discreet and accurate, perfect for the Tenno of distinction.
descriptions.zh: （英文：AKSTILETTO PRIME）时尚、稳定而精准，非常适合那些喜欢与众不同的 Tenno 们。

descriptions.en: Orokin craftsmanship married with superior firepower. Dual Vastos, primed and ready to strike.
descriptions.zh: （英文：AKVASTO PRIME）奥罗金精湛工艺与出众火力的结合。两把瓦斯托，已经装弹待发。

descriptions.en: Orokin gold enhances the conductivity of Gyre Prime's signature rifle, enabling it to fire massive electrifying orbs.
descriptions.zh: （英文：ALTERNOX PRIME）奥罗金黄金增强了 Gyre Prime 标志性步枪的导电性，使其能够发射巨大的带电球体。

descriptions.en: This Orokin variation of the Ankyros is superior to its successor in every way.
descriptions.zh: （英文：ANKYROS PRIME）甲龙双拳的奥罗金版本，在各方面素质都远超其后继者。

descriptions.en: Evoking the design of ancient bows, the high impact Cernos is perfect for hunting down highly shielded enemies.
descriptions.zh: （英文：CERNOS）这把冲击力强大的西诺斯长弓十分擅长猎杀高护盾的敌人，让人回想起古代长弓的设计。

descriptions.en: This laser bladed battle-axe easily hacks through a ship's defenses and the forces protecting it.
descriptions.zh: （英文：ONORIX）这把激光刀刃的战斧能轻易突破船只的防御和保卫船只的武装力量。

descriptions.en: Unload deadly accurate bursts of mayhem.
descriptions.zh: （英文：CYNGAS）释放出致命般精准的爆发性混乱。

descriptions.en: When fully charged, this flak cannon delivers a devastating shot. Perfect for taking down fast-moving interceptors.
descriptions.zh: （英文：CORVAS）充能完毕后，这台高射加农炮能击发出毁灭性的炮击。完美地击落快速移动的拦截机。

descriptions.en: Using Archwing's jets for thrust, this massive hammer crushes anything in its path.
descriptions.zh: 利用了曲翼的喷射推动力，这把巨大的铁锤能击碎其挥舞路径中的任何物体。

descriptions.en: Delivering twin streams of highly accurate, rapid-fire ordnance, the Decurion are specifically designed for combat in the vacuum of space.
descriptions.zh: （英文：DUAL DECURION）什长双枪是专门为了在真空的太空之下战斗，能急速发射双道高精准弹幕的武器。

descriptions.en: Tear apart incoming enemies with this massive hooked blade.
descriptions.zh: （英文：AGKUZA）用这柄强大的钩状刀刃撕裂来袭的敌人。

descriptions.en: Devastate free-space enemies with Phaedra, the Soma's big-sister.
descriptions.zh: （英文：PHAEDRA）借由这把菲德菈——月神最年长的姊妹——纵横太空尽情毁灭敌人。

descriptions.en: When fully charged, the magnetized barrel of the Velocitus accelerates a metal slug to tremendous speeds, piercing hulls and obliterating armor.
descriptions.zh: （英文：VELOCITUS）当充能完成后，极速电磁步枪的磁化枪管能将金属子弹加速至极限，使其轻易的摧毁装甲，贯穿船身。

descriptions.en: An Archwing energy weapon that sends waves of deadly plasma crashing into enemies.
descriptions.zh: （英文：FLUCTUS）一把能射出致命等离子波来击溃敌人的曲翼能量武器。

descriptions.en: Become an angel of death, with this Archwing scythe.
descriptions.zh: （英文：KASZAS）拿起这把曲翼镰刀，化身为死亡天使。

descriptions.en: Part sword, part shield, the Centaur excels at charging headlong into enemy fire.
descriptions.zh: （英文：CENTAUR）部分为剑，部分为盾，半人马剑盾专擅于突进敌军炮火之中。

descriptions.en: Loose explosive glass slugs that tear through enemies with Gara’s signature shotgun, presented here in its spectacular Prime form.
descriptions.zh: （英文：ASTILLA PRIME）Gara 标志性的霰弹枪以惊人的 Prime 形态呈现，可以射出爆炸性的玻璃弹头来击穿敌人。

descriptions.en: Daikyu takes great strength to draw back, but provides added power and range to every shot.
descriptions.zh: （英文：DAIKYU）大久和弓需要相当程度的施力才能开弓，但每次射击同时也提供了更强的威力与更远的射程。

descriptions.en: Reverse-engineered from propulsion tech this hand-cannon packs a kick. Weak Point kills trigger Overdrive, locking off secondary functions while maximizing your fire rate and ammo efficiency for a short time.
descriptions.zh: （英文：ATHODAI）这款强力手枪由喷射推进器技术逆向设计而成。弱点击杀会触发超载状态，该状态将禁用次要射击，并在短时间内最大化你的射速和弹药效率。

descriptions.en: Unleash the song of the righteous warrior with this gilded pistol that goes into Overdrive on headshot kills, maximizing fire rate and ammo efficiency for a short time.
descriptions.zh: 用这把镀金手枪释放正义战士的怒吼，弱点击杀后即可进入超负荷模式，短时间内大幅提升射速和弹药效率。

descriptions.en: The Ballistica crossbow features a unique dual firing mechanism. Choose between a four bolt volley or a deadly accurate charged shot.
descriptions.zh: （英文：BALLISTICA）这把布里斯提卡连弩采用独特的双击发装置，可在四连发或蓄力使用精准的致命射击之间选择。

descriptions.en: The Scindo is a heavy war axe crafted by the Tenno. Reduced speed and agility is balanced by heavy, devastating strikes capable of connecting with multiple targets at once.
descriptions.zh: （英文：SCINDO）分裂斩斧是由 Tenno 精心设计的重型战斧。减少速度和灵活性加强重量，破坏性的攻击能够一次杀伤多个目标。

descriptions.en: The Sentient slayer. An offering from Ballas.
descriptions.zh: （英文：PARACESIS）Sentient 猎杀者。来自 Ballas。

descriptions.en: This rapid-fire classic is the Orokin-engineered definition of silent, pinpoint lethality.
descriptions.zh: （英文：BAZA PRIME）这把经典的高射速冲锋枪体现了奥罗金工艺对于无声和精确杀伤的定义。

descriptions.en: One of the finest examples of Tenno craftsmanship, the Boar Prime offers a higher Fire Rate, Magazine Capacity and a much higher per-shot damage.
descriptions.zh: （英文：BOAR PRIME）Tenno 工艺设计的绝佳案例之一，野猪 Prime 能提供更快的射速、更大的弹匣容量，以及更高的子弹伤害。

descriptions.en: The Bolto fires slow, heavy bolts that are capable of impaling enemies to walls.
descriptions.zh: （英文：BOLTO）螺钉手枪连射速度缓慢，大型的螺钉能把敌人钉在墙上。

descriptions.en: An intimidating Tonfa set designed to match the briary design of the Boltor.
descriptions.zh: （英文：BOLTACE）一对设计成与满身尖刺为造型的螺钉步枪相辅相成的拐刃，有着令人生畏的外观。

descriptions.en: The Boltor fires slow, heavy bolts that are capable of impaling enemies to walls.
descriptions.zh: （英文：BOLTOR）螺钉步枪所发射出的的慢速重型螺钉足以将敌人钉在墙上。

descriptions.en: Fires Orokin designed bolts that are faster and sharper.
descriptions.zh: （英文：BOLTOR PRIME）射出由奥罗金设计、更快更尖锐的螺钉。

descriptions.en: The Kestrel boomerang is a heavy throwing weapon that can knock down enemies at a distance.
descriptions.zh: （英文：KESTREL）红隼回旋镖是把重型投掷武器，可以击倒远处敌人。

descriptions.en: Discovered deep inside an ancient Orokin derelict, the Paris Prime increases the kinetic energy of any bolt it fires, dealing more damage than its more common counterpart.
descriptions.zh: （英文：PARIS PRIME）从遗弃的古老奥罗金船只的深处中发现的帕里斯 Prime，比原版提升了更多箭矢的动能，能造成更多的伤害。

descriptions.en: Simple but powerful. The semi-automatic Brakk hand cannon delivers a lot of punch in a small package.
descriptions.zh: （英文：BRAKK）简单但威力强大，半自动布拉克手枪小型的枪身中却拥有强大的冲击火力。

descriptions.en: The Braton's high rate of fire and accuracy make it a favorite among the Tenno.
descriptions.zh: （英文：BRATON）布莱顿是一支自动步枪。高射速和高精度使其成为了 Tenno 的最爱。

descriptions.en: A classic Orokin weapon, Braton Prime features modified damage levels and a larger magazine over the standard model.
descriptions.zh: （英文：BRATON PRIME）一把经典的  奥罗金兵器，布莱顿 Prime 比起标准版，强化了伤害能力以及更大的弹匣。

descriptions.en: A special version of the standard Braton rifle with a slower Fire Rate but offering higher accuracy and damage values. The Braton Vandal has been customized by the Tenno with a blue-green metallic finish and Lotus branding on the grips.
descriptions.zh: （英文：BRATON VANDAL）布莱顿的特别版本，有着较低的射速，但更高的精准度和伤害。布莱顿·破坏者被 Tenno 定制成蓝绿色金属光泽，并在握把上绘制了 Lotus 纹样。

descriptions.en: These iron fists that rip through foes are Atlas' signature weapons. When wielded by Atlas they receive a Status Chance increase.
descriptions.zh: （英文：TEKKO）这对铁拳的攻击能撕穿敌人，是 Atlas 的标志性武器。在被 Atlas 使用时，它们的触发几率会提升。

descriptions.en: A shattered talisman of the Grineer Elder Queen. It pulls health orbs from deceased enemies and energy orbs from destroyed robots.
descriptions.zh: （英文：BROKEN SCEPTER）Grineer 大女皇的护身物，虽已破碎但仍具有神秘力量。能从死去敌人身上取得生命球，或从被破坏的机器人中取得能量球。

descriptions.en: A fragment of Stalker's War sword, a symbol of his defeat.
descriptions.zh: （英文：BROKEN-WAR）追猎者的战争之剑的碎片，是其落败的象征。

descriptions.en: The Bronco is a small-scale shotgun that can be wielded with one hand. Only effective at close range, it has a limited Magazine Capacity.
descriptions.zh: （英文：BRONCO）野马是可以单手操作的小型霰弹枪。在近距离有效但弹匣容量较少。

descriptions.en: Infused with rare Orokin alloys, the Bronco Prime is a highly efficient weapon, trading an increased Magazine Capacity and damage for a lower rate of fire.
descriptions.zh: （英文：BRONCO PRIME）加入罕见的奥罗金合金，野马 Prime 是一把高效能武器，以射速为代价，提高装弹量和伤害力。

descriptions.en: Once thought lost to the ages, attempts to reengineer the Burston Prime never fully replicated this weapon's power and agility.
descriptions.zh: （英文：BURSTON PRIME）一度以为随着岁月流逝而失去踪迹，尝试研发伯斯顿 Prime 但从没能够复制出往日的威力以及操控性。

descriptions.en: The Burston fires 3-round bursts, which provides a balance between the lethality of automatic rifles and the accuracy of semi-automatic rifles.
descriptions.zh: （英文：BURSTON）伯斯顿是三发点射步枪，在机枪的杀伤力和半自动的准确度之间取得平衡。

descriptions.en: Enveloped in deep red composite enamel, this Penta variant features a higher fire-rate and over-sized magazine.
descriptions.zh: （英文：CARMINE PENTA）由深红色复合珐琅包络的潘塔变体，具有更高的射速和超大容量的弹匣。

descriptions.en: A golden shotgun, forged for those who deliver judgment.
descriptions.zh: （英文：CEDO PRIME）一把金色的霰弹枪，为那些执裁者而打造。

descriptions.en: Obtain enlightenment with this massive hammer that performs a Codex scan on each fatal strike. Scans require an equipped Codex Scanner and an available charge.
descriptions.zh: （英文：HELIOCOR）用这把重型战锤获得启示，它可以在每次毁灭性的攻击时进行资料库扫描。扫描需要携带一个资料库扫描器且有可用的扫描次数。

descriptions.en: Creates miniature gravitational singularities that can be used for scientific study or self-defense.
descriptions.zh: （英文：SIMULOR）能制造出微型的重力奇异点，可用于科学研究或自我防卫。

descriptions.en: This short blade weapon was built using ceramic. It has limited range but comes out fast.
descriptions.zh: （英文：CERAMIC DAGGER）这把短剑使用陶瓷制造的。它的攻击范围有限但是却带来了高攻速。

descriptions.en: Punish those who test your restraint. The first strike in a combo stuns enemies when Cobra & Crane Prime are wielded by Baruuk.
descriptions.zh: （英文：COBRA & CRANE PRIME）向那些考验你克制力的人施予惩罚。在被 Baruuk 使用时，眼镜蛇 & 鹤 Prime 连击中的第一击可以眩晕敌人。

descriptions.en: The Dragon Nikana is forged from ancient Tenno steel. This is a master's weapon, only the most worthy of Tenno may wield it.
descriptions.zh: （英文：DRAGON NIKANA）龙之侍刃是以古代 Tenno 特制的钢铁所铸成。这是大师的武器，只有武艺修为能与之相配的 Tenno 能使用它。

descriptions.en: Heavy in the hand with a bone-crunching kickback. This Prime version of this shotgun adds remote detonation of the weapon's airburst round.
descriptions.zh: （英文：CORINTH PRIME）份量不轻且具有相当的后坐力。这种霰弹枪的 Prime 版本可以将武器射出的空爆弹远程引爆。

descriptions.en: Each successive kill from this massive electron hammer builds an electron charge that is unleashed on slam attacks.
descriptions.zh: （英文：ARCA TITRON）这柄巨型电子重锤的每一次连续击杀都会积累一重电荷，可以通过震地攻击将其释放出来。

descriptions.en: Capable of firing multiple rockets at once, the Angstrum is a handheld instrument of destruction.
descriptions.zh: （英文：ANGSTRUM）能够同时发射若干火箭的安格斯壮是一个手持的毁灭工具。

descriptions.en: The sleek lines of the Detron conceal its ferocious nature. The hand cannon's semi-automatic action takes down enemies with speed and efficiency.
descriptions.zh: （英文：DETRON）德特昂的流线型线条掩饰其凶残本性，这把半自动手枪是快速并有效率地击倒敌人。

descriptions.en: Compact and deadly, the Cestra discharges bolts of energy at an increasingly rapid rate.
descriptions.zh: （英文：CESTRA）小巧而致命的锡斯特，以越来越快的射速释放能量弹。

descriptions.en: Discharge a rail of ionized death or throw the Ferrox like a spear and create a localized field of attraction no enemy can escape from.
descriptions.zh: （英文：FERROX）释放一道电离的死光，或掷出铁晶磁轨炮以产生一个敌人无法逃脱的局部吸引力场。

descriptions.en: Drawing from its huge quad-chambered magazine, the Tetra is capable of unleashing a sustained barrage of lethal energy bolts.
descriptions.zh: （英文：TETRA）借由它巨大的四腔弹匣，特拉能持续发射由能量弹形成的致命弹幕。

descriptions.en: Half taser, half whip. The Corpus Lecta delivers a deadly shock to anything it touches.
descriptions.zh: （英文：LECTA）一半电击器一半鞭子。这条 Corpus 的勒克塔会对接触到的任何东西发出致命电击。
（英文：CORUFELL PRIME）闪劫 Prime 的金色藤蔓让变形更流畅，使重击更迅捷。

descriptions.en: Flaunting ceremonial beauty, this arch gun flak cannon is even more devastating than its standard issue counterpart.
descriptions.zh: （英文：CORVAS PRIME）招摇又考究的美人，这款曲翼枪械版高射炮比其标准版更具破坏性。

descriptions.en: Blasts targets with a massive wave of sonic energy. Results reported to be: 'Very Satisfying'.
descriptions.zh: （英文：SONICOR）以巨大的声波能量震飞目标。使用报告的结果是：非常爽。

descriptions.en: Bring negotiations to an instant conclusion with this Corpus assault rifle. Switch effortlessly between charged explosive shots and rapid-fire electrical assault mode.
descriptions.zh: （英文：AMBASSADOR）使用这支 Corpus 突击步枪让谈判立即结束。可以在充能爆炸狙击和速射电子突击模式之间自由切换。

descriptions.en: Leverage bleeding-edge Granum tech with this massive heavy blade. Slam sends forth a cascading set of three shockwaves, while Heavy Slam unleashes a swath of shockwaves.
descriptions.zh: （英文：TENET EXEC）这把重型巨刃使用了最前沿的格拉努科技。震地攻击会向前发射三道冲击波，而重型震地攻击则会发射大量冲击波。

descriptions.en: Cultivate a meaningful relationship with this deceptively simple battery-powered pistol. The Plinx rewards attention and investment from the wise.
descriptions.zh: （英文：PLINX）与这把看似朴素的电池手枪培养出深厚的情感。漫射者最能回馈来自智者的关注与投资。

descriptions.en: The sleek lines of the Granum Attaché case conceal an infinitely sharp two-handed blade. Blocked attacks have a chance to increase the blocking angle. Note: The Granum Attaché system pauses the combo timer when holstered.
descriptions.zh: （英文：TENET LIVIA）格拉努公文包的流畅线条下隐藏着削铁如泥的双持利刃。格挡攻击有几率增加格挡角度。配备了获得专利批准的格拉努公文包系统，收起时暂停连击倒计时。

descriptions.en: Forgo ammunition with the regenerating energy disc in this plasma throwing pistol.
descriptions.zh: （英文：CYCRON）用这把装有能量恢复圆盘的等离子体发射手枪摆脱弹药的限制。

descriptions.en: An obscure glaive weapon of Corpus provenance, intrinsically linked to Specter technology. The Xoris strikes rapidly and with great devastation. It is capable of chaining combos infinitely.
descriptions.zh: （英文：XORIS）一件来源于 Corpus 且鲜为人知的战刃武器，与魅影技术有内在联系。「驱魔之刃」可以迅速进行打击，并拥有显著的破坏力。此外它可以无限进行连击。

descriptions.en: A short-blade melee weapon with an ace up its sleeve. Send nearby enemies flying with a powerful short-range shockwave.
descriptions.zh: （英文：STROPHA）一件暗藏玄机的短刃近战武器。通过强大的短程冲击波来击飞附近的敌人。

descriptions.en: Drive the agenda with this massive impact hammer. Heavy attacks launch devastating energy disks.
descriptions.zh: （英文：TENET AGENDUS）用这把重型冲击锤推动议程。重击会发射毁灭性的能量盘。

descriptions.en: Nail them to the wall! The Stahlta automatic rifle propels hardened steel rods at high speed, while a charged fire mode fuses a number of volatile rods together for a large radioactive explosion.
descriptions.zh: （英文：STAHLTA）将敌人钉在墙上！这件钢刃自动步枪把硬化钢棒推进到高速状态，而蓄力射击模式会将大量不稳定的钢棒融合在一起，产生巨大的放射性爆炸。

descriptions.en: Sentient tech merges with Corpus design to deliver this lethal sidearm. Fully automatic, it fires ricocheting, homing projectiles that release small clouds of <DT_GAS_COLOR>Gas on impact. Alt-fire to release the entire magazine without homing as a single burst.
descriptions.zh: （英文：CYANEX）Sentient 科技与 Corpus 设计的结合，发展出这款致命的次要武器。该武器为全自动，可射出跳飞式、自动导引的弹幕，子弹在撞击时会释放出小一股 <DT_GAS_COLOR>毒气。次要射击为可在单次射击中释放剩余的弹药。

descriptions.en: Corpus ingenuity leveraging Tau-tech to create a high-capacity bi-modal sniper weapon of terrifying capability. Zoom in to reduce recoil and add punch through. Zoom again to fire a bursting viral round, but with a lower rate of fire. Komorex features built-in ammo conversion.
descriptions.zh: （英文：KOMOREX）Corpus 独具匠心地利用 Tau 技术创造了一把可怕的大弹匣容量狙击枪。变焦可减少后坐力并增加穿透力。再次变焦可发射爆炸的病毒子弹，但射速降低。猛毒有自带的弹药转换。

descriptions.en: A weapon that reaches for its next victim even as it kills. With each takedown, this pistol spawns an energy tendril that reaches for a nearby target.
descriptions.zh: （英文：OCUCOR）在击杀同时便已准备好对下一名受害者伸出魔爪的一种武器。每次击杀，这把手枪会生成能量卷须伸向邻近目标。

descriptions.en: A weapon that builds charge the more it kills. Hit capacity then release for an obliterating discharge of power.
descriptions.zh: （英文：BATTACOR）一把借由击杀敌人来充能的武器。蓄满后可以释放出毁灭性的力量。

descriptions.en: Feel the kick of this Corpus shotgun as it shatters a high-yield crystal into anyone and anything standing in your way.
descriptions.zh: （英文：EXERGIS）当这把 Corpus 霰弹枪将高产水晶轰入阻挡在你前方的任何人或物时，请细细品味其后坐力。

descriptions.en: Shock and maim with this heavyweight retractable whip.
descriptions.zh: （英文：GALVACORD）使用这把重型伸缩鞭施以电击与残害。

descriptions.en: Bring the enemy to its knees with these twin electrified tonfas.
descriptions.zh: （英文：OHMA）用这对带电的双子拐刃使你的敌人跪地求饶。

descriptions.en: This unsophisticated Corpus survival tool does what it was designed for: hacking and splitting whatever it strikes.
descriptions.zh: （英文：KRESKA）这把简易的 Corpus 生存工具履行了它的设计目标：砍杀和分裂任何攻击对象。

descriptions.en: Like the surge and crash of storm waves, a master of the Nami cutlass and Skyla dagger turns these two separate weapons into one fluid attack.
descriptions.zh: （英文：NAMI SKYLA）像暴风雨的汹涌和破坏力一样，精通海波斯库拉对剑的人可以使用这两把不同的武器完成流畅的进攻。

descriptions.en: This short blade weapon forged using dark metals has limited range but comes out fast.
descriptions.zh: （英文：DARK DAGGER）这把用黑暗金属锻造的短刃武器，在有限的范围内可以快速出招。

descriptions.en: Use as a devastating heavy sword or apply a Dual Melee stance and split the weapon into two ferocious blades.
descriptions.zh: （英文：DARK SPLIT-SWORD）能作为强大破坏力的重剑使用，或以近战双持架式将武器化为两把凶残的刀刃。

descriptions.en: The versatile Cinta can fire arrows in quick succession, quickly charge a shock wave, or fully charge a powerful focused shot.
descriptions.zh: （英文：CINTA）遂心的功能非常多样化，可以快速连续地射出箭矢，迅速充能释放冲击震波，或完全充能并进行威力强大的聚焦式射击。

descriptions.en: A warrior who prefers brute force will make the most of Sampotes. Its Slams and Heavy Slams have an extended area of effect.
descriptions.zh: （英文：SAMPOTES）喜欢蛮力的战士会充分利用三宝聚，它的震地攻击和重型震地攻击具有更广的影响范围。

descriptions.en: Syam is at home in the hands of a focused warrior. Its Heavy Attacks send forth shockwaves.
descriptions.zh: （英文：SYAM）业珀在专注的战士手中物尽其用。它的重击会发出冲击波。

descriptions.en: Argo & Vel bolster the warrior who stands fast. Its Heavy Attack sends forth a glaive that ricochets off enemies.
descriptions.zh: （英文：ARGO & VEL）星舟 & 帆为坚守阵地的战士提供支持。它的重击会射出一把会在敌人身上弹开的刀刃。

descriptions.en: Edun befits a dextrous warrior. Heavy Attack to throw Edun. Edun explodes after it is embedded in an enemy.
descriptions.zh: （英文：EDUN）雷石祭适合于机敏的战士。重击以投掷出雷石祭。 雷石祭在刺入敌人体内后便会爆炸。

descriptions.en: Azothane calls the visionary warrior to turn the tides of battle. Block and melee attack at the same time to plunge Azothane into the ground, damaging nearby enemies with a shockwave and adding to the combo counter.
descriptions.zh: （英文：AZOTHANE）溶灵尊会召唤出有远见的战士来扭转战局。同时进行格挡和近战攻击来将溶灵尊插入地面，用其冲击波伤害附近的敌人，并增加连击数。

descriptions.en: A customized version of the Dera, featuring a metallic finish and Lotus decal.
descriptions.zh: （英文：DERA VANDAL）这把是定制化版本的德拉步枪，拥有着金属质感及 Lotus 的徽记。

descriptions.en: Each arrow spawns a swarm of sticky appendages on impact. These tongue-like probes latch onto nearby unfortunates and drag them close before bursting into a mess of diseased goo.
descriptions.zh: （英文：PROBOSCIS CERNOS）每支箭在冲击时都会产生大量的粘稠附着物。这些像舌头一样的探针会吸附在附近的倒霉蛋身上，并把他们拖近，然后爆裂形成一团病害黏液。

descriptions.en: Take mastery to the next level with this primed rapier.
descriptions.zh: （英文：DESTREZA PRIME）用这把 PRIME 细剑将对技巧的掌握提升至更高等级。

descriptions.en: The sleek lines of the Detron conceal its ferocious nature. The hand cannon's semi-automatic action takes down enemies with speed and efficiency.
descriptions.zh: （英文：DETRON）德特昂的流线型线条掩饰其凶残本性，这把半自动手枪是快速并有效率地击倒敌人。

descriptions.en: Each kill with this swooping blade adds bonus damage to the Djinn Sentinel’s next Fatal Attraction ability. In turn, Fatal Attraction bestows the weapon with a period of <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>Corrosive Damage.
descriptions.zh: （英文：GAZAL MACHETE）每次用这把俯冲样式的刀刃击杀会给引灵下一次释放的致命诱惑增加额外的伤害。作为回报，致命诱惑会赋予这把武器一段时间的 <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>腐蚀伤害。

descriptions.en: Sobek is a rapid-firing Grineer shotgun that has reduced damage per shot but boasts extra large magazine capacity.
descriptions.zh: （英文：SOBEK）鳄神是一把速射型 Grineer 霰弹枪，虽降低每一枪的伤害，但拥有超大弹匣容量。

descriptions.en: Forged by a master gunsmith, this Tenno burst rifle will strike down targets with swift precision.
descriptions.zh: （英文：TIBERON）由大师级枪械制造工匠打造的这把 Tenno 三连发步枪可以迅速精确地击倒目标。

descriptions.en: Short axes held in each hand. High attack speed and can hit multiple targets. Delivers a high percentage of critical strikes.
descriptions.zh: （英文：DUAL ZOREN）双手各为轴心挥砍。高攻速且能同时攻击多目标。高暴击几率。

descriptions.en: A Bronco equipped in each hand.
descriptions.zh: （英文：AKBRONCO）双手各持一把野马。

descriptions.en: Butcher your foes with brutal blades in each hand.
descriptions.zh: （英文：DUAL CLEAVERS）双持野蛮刀刃来屠宰你的敌人。

descriptions.en: Wield two Cestras to unleash a dual torrent of high energy bolts.
descriptions.zh: （英文：DUAL CESTRA）双手各持一把锡斯特释放出双流高能量弹幕。

descriptions.en: These matching stilettos have increased attack speed and can unleash a flurry of multi-hit attacks.
descriptions.zh: （英文：FANG）这对纤细的短剑有着增强的攻速并且能发动旋风般的多重攻击。

descriptions.en: A shorter version of the Ether blade that allows for a more focused attack on a single target.
descriptions.zh: （英文：ETHER DAGGERS）为了强化其对单体攻击而减短苍穹刀身的长度的苍穹。

descriptions.en: Fast and precise. The Dual Ether cuts so cleanly that it was considered by the Tenno to be a more humane weapon for ‘cleansing' infested allies. Capable of hitting multiple targets.
descriptions.zh: 迅速而精准。正因为苍穹双剑干净利落的斩击，使得 Tenno 认为它是「净化」受到感染的盟友时更慈悲的武器。苍穹双剑一次能击中复数敌人。

descriptions.en: With a Heat Sword in each hand, enemies reach their fiery demise twice as fast. Can connect with multiple targets at once.
descriptions.zh: （英文：DUAL HEAT SWORDS）每只手紧握一把烈焰之剑，双倍加强敌人在炽热中消亡的速度。能同时攻击多个目标。

descriptions.en: Wielding a Kama in each hand brings a savage amount of <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Damage to bear against your enemies.
descriptions.zh: （英文：DUAL KAMAS）两手各挥舞一把短柄战镰产生野蛮的<DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割伤害来对抗敌人。

descriptions.en: The hunted will meet a quick end when faced with Khora Prime's signature swords. Heavy Attack Efficiency is enhanced when wielded by Khora.
descriptions.zh: （英文：DUAL KERES PRIME）当猎物面对 Khora Prime 的标志性双刀时，生命将迅速终结。Khora 挥舞双刀时，其重击效率会被增强。

descriptions.en: Twice the ammo and twice the stopping power of a single Magnus.
descriptions.zh: （英文：AKMAGNUS）和一把麦格努斯相比有双倍弹药和双倍后坐力。

descriptions.en: Razor sharp battle-hatchets, designed to compliment the Soma.
descriptions.zh: （英文：DUAL RAZA）这组锐利战斧是为了配合月神而设计的。

descriptions.en: A shorter Skana in each hand. Can hit multiple targets.
descriptions.zh: （英文：DUAL SKANA）每只手拿一把较短的空刃。能同时攻击多个目标。

descriptions.en: Vasto revolvers equipped in each hand.
descriptions.zh: （英文：AKVASTO）双手各持一把瓦斯托左轮手枪。

descriptions.en: Axes worthy of an executioner, refined to Orokin perfection.
descriptions.zh: （英文：DUAL ZOREN PRIME）这是两把配得上行刑者的斧头，是奥罗金工艺登峰造极的体现。
（英文：NUNCHASA）Narin 的标志性弓箭是北风的冰霜使者。次要开火模式会释放一支充能暴雪箭，冻结接触到的敌人并留下一道寒冰的痕迹。
（英文：AKSONDOL）Narin 的标志性手枪威力十足，如同凛冬的寒风。每次装填都会释放出一道寒冷的脉冲，使敌人陷入冰冻异常状态，脉冲的范围会随着装填次数的增加而扩大。

descriptions.en: Teshin's twin blades.
descriptions.zh: （英文：SUN & MOON）Teshin 的双侍刃。

descriptions.en: This Heavy Scythe echoes battles of another time. It is far more a weapon of sheer force than one of finesse.
descriptions.zh: （英文：HESPAR）这把重型镰刀呼应了另一个时代的战斗。其更像是一种纯粹的力量型武器，而不是一种技巧型武器。

descriptions.en: This unusual automatic rifle feels strangely familiar and has two fire modes. Primary fire packs radiation damage. Alternate fire charges up to launch an explosive projectile.
descriptions.zh: （英文：AEOLAK）这把非同寻常的自动步枪给人一种奇异的熟悉感，并且拥有两种开火模式。主要射击附带辐射伤害，次要射击充能后可发射一枚爆炸投射物。

descriptions.en: Turn the enemy's worst nightmare into reality with Follie's signature rifle. The Enkaus will instantly kill and dissolve inked enemies that are damaged at low health. Shooting inked enemies siphons ink back into the Enkaus, allowing for a constant flow of creative destruction.
descriptions.zh: （英文：ENKAUS）使用 Follie 的标志性步枪将敌人的噩梦化为现实。当被墨汁侵染的敌人生命值较低时，绘墨会瞬间将其击杀并溶解。射击被墨汁侵染的敌人可将墨水回流至绘墨，实现持续不断的创造性破坏。

descriptions.en: Albrecht's Void experiments revealed the true destructive potential of this fist weapon. In Incarnon form, perform Heavy Slams to impale nearby enemies with spikes.
descriptions.zh: （英文：RUVOX）阿尔布雷希特的虚空实验揭示了这把拳套武器的真正破坏潜力。在灵化形态下，使用重型震地攻击会以尖刺刺穿附近的敌人。

descriptions.en: Wield the timeless power of this mighty hammer. Heavy Attacks performed with Ekhein temporarily increase its Damage and Attack Speed.
descriptions.zh: （英文：EKHEIN）掌控这把强大战锤的永恒力量。使用映声战锤进行的重击会暂时增加其伤害和攻击速度。

descriptions.en: Albrecht's Void experiments revealed the true destructive potential of this weapon. In Incarnon form, draw in ambient power to deal steadily increased damage to enemies. At full power, release a blast of <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat.
descriptions.zh: （英文：ONOS）阿尔布雷希特的虚空实验揭示了这把武器的真正破坏潜力。在灵化形态下，吸收周围的能量对敌人造成逐渐增加的伤害。当能量充满时，释放一股 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰爆炸。

descriptions.en: Send shivers down your enemies' spines with this wrist-mounted sidearm. As the signature weapon of Sevagoth Prime, it deals additional headshot damage when wielded by him.
descriptions.zh: （英文：EPITAPH PRIME）这把腕式次要武器让你的敌人不寒而栗。作为 Sevagoth Prime 的标志性武器，由他使用时可造成额外的爆头伤害。

descriptions.en: With a blade forged from the same material as the Ether Sword, the Ether Reaper delivers quick death to its victims.
descriptions.zh: （英文：ETHER REAPER）采用与苍穹之剑相同材质来锻造刀身，让苍穹镰刀迅速的为受害者献上死亡。

descriptions.en: A single blade for more precision. The Ether Sword cuts so cleanly that it was considered by the Tenno to be a more humane weapon for ‘cleansing' infested allies.
descriptions.zh: （英文：ETHER SWORD）苍穹之剑的斩切非常锐利，是一把精准的刀刃，被认为是 Tenno 用来清除受感染伙伴的慈悲武器。

descriptions.en: In the early Orokin Empire, elites wore Innodem as a symbolic reminder to defend the defenseless. The tradition fell out of style, but nostalgic elites acknowledged the sentiment in the form of a gift. The Void amplifies that ideal. Void energy strengthens Innodem gliding aerial attacks and the wielder is increasingly resilient as they perform finisher attacks in Incarnon Form.
descriptions.zh: （英文：INNODEM）在早期的奥罗金帝国，精英们会佩戴清刚作为提醒他们保护手无寸铁者的象征。这种传统早已过时了，但念旧的精英们有时会以礼物的形式认可这种理念。而虚空则放大了这一理念，虚空能量增强了这把武器的滑翔制空攻击之力；当佩戴者在灵化形态下进行处决攻击时，会感受到这把武器增强的韧性。

descriptions.en: During parades and victory marches, the Laetum fired pigmented airburst rounds that rained onto festive crowds. The Orokin sent Laetum with the Zariman so they could properly celebrate a successful maiden voyage to Tau. There would be no such celebration, but the Void imbued the Laetum with a much more explosive capacity.
descriptions.zh: （英文：LAETUM）在阅兵式和得胜行军期间，人们会用奏凯发射色彩缤纷的空爆弹化作鲜艳的雨点落在欢庆的人群身上。奥罗金人将奏凯送上了「扎里曼号」，以便他们能够好好庆祝前往 Tau 星系的成功首航。虽然这样的庆祝活动从未发生，但虚空给奏凯赋予了更强的爆炸之力。

descriptions.en: The Felarx invokes ancient times when aristocrats hunted game. For ceremonies, Orokin elites bred creatures reminiscent of game birds to reanimate cultural myths. They gave the Zariman crew Felarx and a brace of birds as a sign of acceptance into elite society. The brace of birds becomes a pair of pistols at the hands of the Void.
descriptions.zh: （英文：FELARX）逐枭唤起了古代贵族狩猎活动的历史。为了仪式，奥罗金精英培育出与其狩猎的猛禽相像之生物来重现文化传说。他们赐予「扎里曼号」船员逐枭和一对猛禽，作为接受船员们进入精英社会的标志。而这对猛禽在虚空的作用下变成了一对手枪。

descriptions.en: Zariman colonists originally intended to use the Phenmor in burial rites. In Orokin society, the higher the rank, the greater number of volleys for the deceased. Its stock is carved from Phenaureus Pine, a tree designed to release seedlings only onto scorched earth. In the hands of the Void, the Phenmor becomes darkly aggressive.
descriptions.zh: （英文：PHENMOR）扎里曼殖民者们最初是希望在葬礼上使用凤殁的。在奥罗金的社会体系中，越高阶级的逝者葬礼上，人们为了纪念逝者射出的子弹数量就越多。这把武器的枪托由只在焦土上释放幼苗的樟子松雕刻而成。在与虚空的接触中，凤殁充满了阴暗的侵略性。

descriptions.en: Orokin elites admired farmers in conquered regions, because they had learned to fight with modified farming tools despite being forbidden to own weapons. For their voyage, the Zariman were presented with Praedos in recognition of Zariman tenacity. The Void reinforces the strength of the spirited individual by fortifying the Praedos.
descriptions.zh: （英文：PRAEDOS）奥罗金精英很佩服那些被征服地区的农夫，他们在武器禁令的压制下学会了通过改良的农具来进行战斗。当「扎里曼号」启航时，船上的人们获得了双雄以表彰他们坚韧不拔的精神。虚空通过增强双雄的力量来奖励使用该武器的人。

descriptions.en: A set of ceremonial daggers from the Orokin era, the Fang Prime's blades resonate violently as they strike. This allows them to pierce hardened materials like armor with ease.
descriptions.zh: （英文：FANG PRIME）一组来自奥罗金时代的仪式匕首，狼牙 Prime 的攻击使刀片猛烈共振，这使得它们能够轻易刺穿坚硬材质如护甲。

descriptions.en: Scope out the enemy with this long-range revolver style rifle.
descriptions.zh: （英文：RUBICO）以这把长距离转轮式步枪彻底探清敌人。

descriptions.en: During the darkest days of the Old War many a Tenno relied solely on the Tonbo to keep them alive.
descriptions.zh: （英文：TONBO）在远古之战中最黑暗的那几天中，许多 Tenno 仅能靠着蜻蛉薙生还下来。

descriptions.en: A beautifully forged instrument of devastation.
descriptions.zh: （英文：FRAGOR PRIME）一把为了摧毁一切而锻造的终极兵器。

descriptions.en: Wield a storm. Fulmin Prime's electric rounds switch between lightning beams and short-range bursts. Wisp quickly swaps between each mode with her elemental prowess.
descriptions.zh: （英文：FULMIN PRIME）唤起风暴。雷霆 Prime 的电击弹可在闪电光束和短距离点射之间切换。Wisp 凭借她的元素之力获得更快的模式切换速度。

descriptions.en: These power gauntlets lack the range of most Melee Weapons, but Furax is far more devastating when you strike an enemy in close combat.
descriptions.zh: （英文：FURAX）这动力拳套较大部分近战武器距离更短，但在近战中表现更为优秀。

descriptions.en: These Wraith gauntlets have been augmented for power.
descriptions.zh: （英文：FURAX WRAITH）这些亡魂手套已经在力量上得到了强化。

descriptions.en: The Furis delivers a high damage output in a short time frame thanks to its high rate of fire.
descriptions.zh: （英文：FURIS）盗贼是一把自动手枪，这小东西拥有极高的射速。

descriptions.en: Orokin-era Grineer plated their scythes with gold as a symbol of dedication to their Golden Lords. Gains a percentage of Critical Chance with each Status Type affecting the target.
descriptions.zh: （英文：GALARIAK PRIME）奥罗金时代的 Grineer 战士将镰刀镀上黄金，以此象征他们对黄金之主的忠诚。每有一种异常状态影响目标，镰刀的暴击几率就会提升一定百分比。

descriptions.en: Slash targets with a single precise bolt from Garuda's signature crossbow. Alt-fire to let loose a barrage of bolts. All bolts have a chance to cause <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status, and Headshots have a chance to increase Reload Speed. When wielded by Garuda Nagantaka gains a slight Punch Through.
descriptions.zh: （英文：NAGANTAKA）Garuda 的标志性十字弓能以一支精准的弩矢斩断目标，而次要射击则能发射出弩矢弹幕；每支弩矢都有可能造成 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割异常状态，爆头射击则可加快装填速度。在被 Garuda 使用时，噬蛇弩会获得少量的穿透效果。

descriptions.en: A pair of mighty gauntlets, the Ankyros were designed by the Tenno for close quarters combat. What they lack in range they make up for in speed.
descriptions.zh: （英文：ANKYROS）一对强大的拳套，甲龙双拳是由 Tenno 专为近身格斗所设计。牺牲攻击范围以换取更快的攻击速度。

descriptions.en: Dating back to the time of the first Tenno, the Glaive is a uniquely deadly weapon. This multi-bladed disc is not only effective for melee combat; it can also be thrown like a boomerang to cut down enemies at a distance.
descriptions.zh: （英文：GLAIVE）在第一个 Tenno 的时代，战刃是一件奇怪而强大的武器。这多刀刃圆盘不单可用于近身战，更可如回力镖般使用，在一定距离外把敌人一分为二。

descriptions.en: The Glaive Prime is a deadly and beautiful weapon from the Orokin era. The blades are as effective in close quarters as they are when thrown at distant enemies.
descriptions.zh: （英文：GLAIVE PRIME）战刃 Prime 在奥罗金时代是一把致命和优美的武器，其刀刃在近距离战斗时也与对远距离敌人掷出时一样有效。

descriptions.en: Tear and maim with this agile, lightweight glass hammer. When Gara's wields her signature melee weapon, it gains additional Slam Radial Damage.
descriptions.zh: （英文：VOLNUS）用这把轻量灵活的玻璃锤来撕裂并残害目标。Gara 的标志性近战武器。在被 Gara 使用时，它会获得额外的震地范围伤害。

descriptions.en: Silently lacerate enemies with Gara's signature glass throwing knives. Increased Projectile Speed when wielded by Gara.
descriptions.zh: （英文：FUSILAI）无声地以 Gara 的标志性玻璃飞刀撕裂敌人。在被 Gara 使用时，该武器的投射物飞行速度会提升。

descriptions.en: The Gorgon sports a large magazine that allows it to provide suppressing fire and sustain a high damage rate over a long time. Its high Fire Rate is only achieved following a short wind-up cycle.
descriptions.zh: （英文：GORGON）蛇发女妖是一把重机枪。巨大的弹匣使它能够提供压制火力并长时间维持高伤害率。

descriptions.en: The Gorgon Wraith is a powerful variant of its precursor that features unique styling.
descriptions.zh: （英文：GORGON WRAITH）蛇发女妖·亡魂是其前身的强大变体，以它独特的风格为特色。

descriptions.en: Born anew, the father of swords returns.
descriptions.zh: （英文：GRAM PRIME）全然新生，诸剑之祖已经回归。

descriptions.en: The heavy two-handed sword known as Gram requires great strength to wield, but it is notorious for its splitting power. Can hit multiple targets with each strike.
descriptions.zh: （英文：GRAM）这把名为格拉姆的大剑以其强大的斩击力令人闻风丧胆，需要巨力才可挥舞自如。其攻击可以击中多名敌人。

descriptions.en: Designed as a pair, these Grineer sidearms fire projectiles at a slower rate but with greater force and accuracy.
descriptions.zh: （英文：TWIN GREMLINS）这把 Grineer 随身武器被设计成一对，虽然开火速度较慢，但有更强大的火力和准确性。

descriptions.en: The Penta Launcher fires up to five grenades that can be remotely triggered at just the right moment.
descriptions.zh: （英文：PENTA）潘塔发射器最多可发射五发榴弹，并在最适当的时候进行远距离引爆。

descriptions.en: Claim the power of Albrecht Entrati's knowledge. Customize the Grimoire with Tome Mods that enhance Warframe Abilities and reward strategic combat. Its alternate attack releases a voltaic orb with guaranteed <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity Status.
descriptions.zh: （英文：GRIMOIRE）获取阿尔布雷希特·英择谛的全知之力。使用典籍 Mod 增强战甲技能并获得战术优势。次要射击发射一颗必定造成 <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>电击异常状态的电弧球。

descriptions.en: Built for close combat, the Sheev's plasma blade slices through flesh and armor with equal ease.
descriptions.zh: （英文：SHEEV）专为近身战斗设计，希芙的等离子刀刃能轻而易举切开肉体与护甲。

descriptions.en: Built for close combat, the Sheev's plasma blade slices through flesh and armor with equal ease.
descriptions.zh: （英文：SHEEV）专为近身战斗设计，希芙的等离子刀刃能轻而易举切开肉体与护甲。

descriptions.en: The Drakgoon flak cannon sends volleys of intensely hot shrapnel ricocheting around the room. Can be fired in wide or concentrated bursts.
descriptions.zh: （英文：DRAKGOON）龙骑兵破片炮可击发出会四处弹射的高热弹片。能以散射或压缩集中的方式进行射击。

descriptions.en: Firing a sticky, toxic, explosive compound, the Stug Gel Gun offers multiple ejection modes, delivering maximum damage in all situations.
descriptions.zh: （英文：STUG）史特克凝胶枪能发射出一种粘稠、有毒的爆炸混合物。且具有多种发射模式，在各种情况下都能造成最大伤害。

descriptions.en: Simple but powerful. The semi-automatic Brakk hand cannon delivers a lot of punch in a small package.
descriptions.zh: （英文：BRAKK）简单但威力强大，半自动布拉克手枪小型的枪身中却拥有强大的冲击火力。

descriptions.en: Deliver crushing blows with this Grineer built, jet powered mace.
descriptions.zh: （英文：JAT KITTAG）Grineer 所制造的喷射动力锤能造成粉碎性的打击。

descriptions.en: A full-auto pistol known as the most compact and lightweight weapon of the Grineer arsenal. Though it has a small Magazine Capacity, the Viper has a very high Fire Rate and ultra-fast reload times thanks to a simplified magazine design.
descriptions.zh: （英文：VIPER）Grineer 军械库中小巧轻便的代名词。蝰蛇是一把弹匣容量细小的全自动手枪，其精简化的弹匣为其带来高射速及惊人的重新装填速度。

descriptions.en: Solid, dependable and deadly. The Karak is a standard issue rifle in many Grineer platoons.
descriptions.zh: （英文：KARAK）结实、可靠又致命。卡拉克是很多Grineer小队的一把标准配置步枪。

descriptions.en: A multi-bladed whip that is adept at flaying skin from bone. In extreme cases, disobedient Grineer are sentenced to death by Atterax.
descriptions.zh: （英文：ATTERAX）擅长将皮肤从骨头上剥下的多刃鞭。在极端情况下，不听话的 Grineer 可以用阿特拉克斯判处死刑。

descriptions.en: A compact four-barreled design packing a self-charging capacitor that discharges upon every reload from empty. Features auto hip-fire and aimed fire is semi-auto, four-shot instant burst.
descriptions.zh: （英文：QUATZ）拥有紧凑的四管设计且装有一个自充电电容器，会在空枪装填时释放电流。腰射时为自动模式，瞄准时为瞬间射出四发子弹模式。

descriptions.en: Equipped with a huge Magazine and impressive Fire Rate, the Grakata is the preferred weapon of Grineer Lancers.
descriptions.zh: （英文：GRAKATA）装备了巨大弹匣，拥有非凡的射速。葛拉卡达是 Grineer 枪兵的首选。

descriptions.en: This jet powered Grineer throwing mace always comes back to its master and is even capable of disarming targets.
descriptions.zh: （英文：HALIKAR）这个Grineer 喷射动力飞锤，其冲击足以解除被击中者的武装，且投掷后总是能回到使用者手上。

descriptions.en: A powerful mid-range rifle used by Grineer shock troops, the Hind fires in five round bursts.
descriptions.zh: （英文：HIND）由 Grineer 突击部队使用的强力中阶步枪，雌鹿一次射击就是五连发。

descriptions.en: Unload a barrage of explosives or a huge shot of flak from this cannon’s enormous barrel.
descriptions.zh: （英文：ZARR）从这具火炮的巨型炮管可以倾泻出爆裂的弹幕或者一枚大型的高射炮弹。

descriptions.en: Rend enemies and up the heat with these mining tools repurposed into machine-tonfa. Building the Combo Multiplier overheats the Tonkkatts, setting enemies ablaze.
descriptions.zh: （英文：TONKKATT）用这对由采矿工具改装而来的拐刃撕裂并点燃你的敌人。积累连击倍率将使武器过热，让敌人熊熊燃烧。

descriptions.en: Motorized saw claw weapon.
descriptions.zh: （英文：RIPKAS）机动型巨爪武器。

descriptions.en: These nasty, little hatchets slice through steel as if it were flesh.
descriptions.zh: （英文：TWIN BASOLK）这对棘手凶恶的小型短斧斩铁如泥，断钢如削肉。

descriptions.en: The cruelest of weapons built for the crudest of Grineer soldiers. Rips through metal like flesh, and through flesh like day-old pudding.
descriptions.zh: （英文：GHOULSAW）为那些最粗鲁的 Grineer 士兵所打造的最残忍的武器。削铁如肉，割肉如泥。

descriptions.en: Hurl mayhem and destruction with this Grineer grenade launcher.
descriptions.zh: （英文：TONKOR）以这把 Grineer 榴弹发射器对敌人猛烈射出暴乱与破坏。

descriptions.en: Spike enemies to the wall or reel them in with this burst harpoon gun.
descriptions.zh: （英文：HARPAK）以这把爆裂鱼叉枪卷起敌人，或将他们钉在墙上。

descriptions.en: This particle cannon generates a condensed beam of super-heated plasma designed to melt rock to ore, and enemies to molten slag.
descriptions.zh: （英文：ATOMOS）这把粒子加农炮能产生由超高温等离子体凝聚而成的射线。而这种射线可以用来冶炼矿石，也可以将敌人化为熔渣。

descriptions.en: The Kraken is a heavy pistol of Grineer design that fires two quick shots with a single pull of the trigger. Skilled marksmen will appreciate the value in this deadly accurate weapon.
descriptions.zh: （英文：KRAKEN）北海巨妖是一把由 Grineer 设计、手感沉重的手枪，单扣扳机可迅速击出两连发射击。熟练的神枪手一定懂得这把致命精准武器的价值。

descriptions.en: These twin barrels of destruction are the signature pistols of the Kuva Guardians.
descriptions.zh: （英文：TWIN ROGGA）这对能够带来破坏的枪管是赤毒守卫者手枪标志性的特征。

descriptions.en: The Slaytra is a powerful reiteration of the traditional Grineer Machete that doubles the duration of <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status Effects.
descriptions.zh: （英文：SLAYTRA）屠煞是对传统 Grineer 砍刀的强大重现，它可以使 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割伤害的出血持续时间加倍。

descriptions.en: Built by the Grineer for their elite troopers, the Vulkar is a devastating distance weapon. In the right hands it is capable of taking down targets long before they get into attack range.
descriptions.zh: （英文：VULKAR）Grineer 为其精锐部队制造，金工火神是一把毁灭性的远程兵器。在正确的使用者手中它能在目标进入攻击距离之前将其迅速放倒。

descriptions.en: For every shot fired in rapid succession the Kohm releases an additional bolt and grows more lethal.
descriptions.zh: （英文：KOHM ）寇恩热能枪在每一次高速连续的射击时都会额外击发出一发能量弹，使其更具杀伤力。

descriptions.en: When they go high, go low. Powerful pneumatic grips and toecaps amplify every blow. Four ways to deal twice the pain.
descriptions.zh: （英文：KORRUDO）当他们出上拳的时候，你就出下拳。强大的气动握把和尖锐的部分可以强化每一次攻击。多达四种方法来施放双倍的痛苦。

descriptions.en: Fashioned with Grineer materials and balanced for marine infantry use, the Amphis is a traditional staff weapon that has received a monstrous makeover that enables shock damage on jump attacks. Connects with multiple enemies with each strike.
descriptions.zh: （英文：AMPHIS）以 Grineer 材料制成，设计为海军陆战队使用，双头蛇是一把为了附带电击伤害而接受了大幅改造的传统棍棒武器——跳跃攻击附带电击伤害。可以同时打击多个敌人。

descriptions.en: Rain hell on the enemy with this handheld cluster-rocket launcher.
descriptions.zh: （英文：KULSTAR）使用这把手持集束火箭发射器，对敌人投以地狱之火。

descriptions.en: What the Aegrit lacks in quantity it makes up for in destructive power. Toss the Aegrit onto your enemy’s position then detonate remotely at the right moment for maximum destructive effect.
descriptions.zh: （英文：AEGRIT）骇敌榴弹虽然数量稀少但威力来补。将骇敌榴弹投掷到敌人的位置，然后在适当的时机远程引爆，以获得最大的破坏效果。

descriptions.en: That a god might reap a harvest of lives.
descriptions.zh: （英文：GUANDAO PRIME）收割生命之神。

descriptions.en: Heavy attacks briefly transform the Corufell into a Gunblade. After the Gunblade fires, the Corufell returns to its Heavy Scythe state. Its transformation is fastest in Citrine's hands.
descriptions.zh: （英文：CORUFELL）重击会在短时间内将闪劫变形为一把枪刃。枪刃开火后，闪劫返回其重型镰刀状态。Citrine 使用时，它的变形速度最为快速。

descriptions.en: Depend on Higasa when it rains bullets. Aiming creates a shield that blocks weapon fire. Kills and blocked shots charge a beam released by Alternate Fire.
descriptions.zh: （英文：HIGASA）依靠晴日伞抵御如雨倾泻的子弹。瞄准可形成一面盾牌，阻挡敌方武器的射击。击杀和阻挡射击将为次要射击充能，以释放光束。

descriptions.en: Command the beauty and lethality of these ornate warfans.
descriptions.zh: （英文：GUNSEN PRIME）让这对华丽的武扇彰显其绝美的杀伤力。

descriptions.en: Gyre's signature weapon has two fire modes. Primary fire shocks enemies with electrical orbs. Alternate fire is a large ball of electricity that sticks to any surface and pulses <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity before it explodes. In Gyre's hands, the weapon has a small amount of multishot.
descriptions.zh: （英文：ALTERNOX）Gyre 的标志性武器有两种射击模式。主要射击可通过带电球体攻击敌人。次要射击可产生一个大型带电球体，该球体可附着在任何表面并在爆炸之前产生 <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>带电脉冲。被 Gyre 使用时，该武器可产生少量的多重射击。

descriptions.en: A large two-handed hammer, the Fragor requires great strength to wield, but impacts with enough force to send groups of enemies tumbling.
descriptions.zh: （英文：FRAGOR）巨大的双手锤，重击巨锤拥有能将复数敌人击飞的力量。

descriptions.en: The choice weapon of Mirage, these fast-firing dual pistols deliver a deadly performance.
descriptions.zh: （英文：AKZANI）作为 Mirage 的精选武器，这些高射速的双手枪将为您带来一场致命的演出。

descriptions.en: This short blade weapon has limited range but comes out fast and can inflict fire damage.
descriptions.zh: （英文：HEAT DAGGER）这把短剑攻击范围有限，但挥动速度快，同时可以造成火焰伤害。

descriptions.en: A strong blade capable of inflicting <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Damage to its foes.
descriptions.zh: （英文：HEAT SWORD）其强力的刀刃能对敌人造成 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割伤害。

descriptions.en: Based on one of the world's oldest weapon designs, this Tenno-crafted weapon can be used both in stealth and in open combat. The Paris uses a chargeable magnetic field to launch arrows capable of impaling enemies to walls.
descriptions.zh: （英文：PARIS）以世界最古老的武器设计为基础，Tenno 所制作的武器不论隐匿行动和交火接战均可使用。帕里斯可利用磁场蓄力，其射出的箭矢足以将敌人钉在墙上。

descriptions.en: Versatile weapons complement deadly hunters. Khora Prime’s signature pistol rotates through hot, cold, electric, and toxic quills. When equipped on Khora, Hystrix Prime has a chance to instantly reload after headshots.
descriptions.zh: （英文：HYSTRIX PRIME）灵活多变的武器与致命的猎人相得益彰。Khora Prime 的标志性手枪可在火焰、冰冻、电击和毒素刺镖中轮换。当 Khora 装备上豪猪 Prime 并造成爆头时，则弹药有几率立即重新装填。

descriptions.en: Ice in motion can crush mountains, this frozen hammer is no different.
descriptions.zh: （英文：SIBEAR）冰移可以碾碎山峰，这把冰锤的效果也是一样。

descriptions.en: A long range rifle capable of firing in space, the Imperator's versatility makes it an ideal weapon for space combat.
descriptions.zh: （英文：IMPERATOR）能在太空中开火的长射程步枪，凯旋将军的多用性使得它成为在太空作战时理想的武器。

descriptions.en: The Imperator Vandal has been customized by the Tenno with a blue-green metallic finish and Lotus branding on the barrel.
descriptions.zh: （英文：IMPERATOR VANDAL）这款为 Tenno 量身打造的凯旋将军·破坏者带有蓝绿色的金属质感，枪管上还有 Lotus 的铭刻。

descriptions.en: Splatter enemies with a short-range stream of corrosive bile and then toss the ammo bladder as a grenade when reloading. The emptier the pistol’s ammo bladder, the more potent its damage. A fully empty bladder packs the biggest punch.
descriptions.zh: （英文：CATABOLYST）可在短距离内向敌人喷射腐蚀性胆汁，此外，弹药囊腔可在装填时被用作投掷手雷。手枪的弹药囊腔越空，其造成的伤害就越强。完全射空的囊腔能发挥出最大的威力。

descriptions.en: Each strike of this infested glaive infects its target with viral pathogens. Occasionally, it discharges the spores of rabid, enemy-seeking maggots, either in-flight or on contact with the enemy.
descriptions.zh: （英文：PATHOCYST）这把感染战刃的每一次攻击都会让目标感染病原体。而在飞行或与敌人接触时，它偶尔还会释放出狂乱的孢子以及追踪敌人的蛆虫。

descriptions.en: Overcome with Infestation, this bow's arrows now spread poisonous contagion to any surface they hit.
descriptions.zh: （英文：MUTALIST CERNOS）受到感染者的侵蚀后，这把弓的箭矢能够在击中的任何表面散播病毒。

descriptions.en: Pummel and infect with these two pulsating hunks of flesh connected by a ligament. Take-hold of the malignant evolution of an ancient martial weapon.
descriptions.zh: （英文：PULMONARS）用这两块被韧带连接的脉动肉块进行击打和感染。掌握古代军用武器的恶毒演变。

descriptions.en: This long-distance rifle fires a razor-sharp, virus-soaked barb that continues to attack its host before violently erupting in a spore-laden mist. Scoped headshots increase lethality.
descriptions.zh: （英文：SPOROTHRIX）这把长射程步枪发射锋利且浸透病毒的倒钩，在猛烈爆发出充满孢子的雾气前，它会继续攻击其宿主。开镜爆头可增加杀伤力。

descriptions.en: An instrument of unrelenting harm. If Lesion tastes blood, it becomes invigorated with faster Attack Speed and increased <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin Damage.
descriptions.zh: （英文：LESION）能造成严重伤害的一把武器。如果病变尝到了血的味道，其就会变得很有活力，攻击速度加快的同时会增加 <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素伤害。

descriptions.en: Leave your mark with these infected claws with increased heavy attack range. Heavy attack at max combo to keep the extended range and slam radius for 3 minutes.
descriptions.zh: （英文：KERATINOS）这些感染利爪可以在更大的重击范围内留下你的印记。达到最高连击数时进行重击，可以保持持续三分钟的、更大的攻击范围和震地半径。

descriptions.en: Infect your foes with this spore-scattering pistol. Headshots burrow in and explode, releasing spore clouds that seek out nearby enemies.
descriptions.zh: （英文：ZYMOS）用这件散射孢子的手枪来感染你的敌人。爆头射击会钻入敌人的体内并爆炸，释放出飘向附近敌人的孢子云。

descriptions.en: Slash through enemies with two leaves of the exceedingly rare Arum Spinosa plant. Heavy Attack to whip a flurry of toxic spines at ranged attackers.
descriptions.zh: （英文：ARUM SPINOSA）用两片极其罕见的疆南星刺植物的叶子砍杀敌人。重击对范围内的攻击者抽出一连串的毒刺。

descriptions.en: The Tysis pistol spits out caustic darts that corrode their victims from within.
descriptions.zh: （英文：TYSIS）啐沫者手枪借由喷吐出具有腐蚀性的毒镖，将受害者由内而外地侵蚀殆尽。

descriptions.en: Rip into the enemy with fists of razor sharp cartilage. Steals health with each critical hit.
descriptions.zh: （英文：HIRUDO）以拳头上如同剃刀般的锋利软骨切入敌人，每次暴击时窃取生命。

descriptions.en: Fires seven beams of continuous biochemical energy which depletes the life of any surface they contact.
descriptions.zh: （英文：PHAGE）射出七道持续性的生化能量，侵蚀任何物质的表面，使其寿命枯竭。

descriptions.en: A blade with a serrated edge that delivers strong quick attacks.
descriptions.zh: （英文：JAW SWORD）拥有锯齿状的刀刃，能够施以强力斩击。

descriptions.en: A different take on the Grineer assault rifle, the Karak Wraith features unique styling.
descriptions.zh: （英文：KARAK WRAITH）有别于 Grineer 制式的突击步枪，卡拉克·亡魂有着独一无二的风格。

descriptions.en: This master blade is the heavier, oversized and far more lethal version of the signature weapon of an extinct order of Tenno assassins.
descriptions.zh: （英文：KARYST PRIME）作为一群已绝迹的 Tenno 刺客的标志性武器，这把大师之刃比原版显得更厚重、更大，以及更为致命。

descriptions.en: The Nikana reintroduces a lost Tenno blade and with it another fragment of the old ways.
descriptions.zh: （英文：NIKANA）利用远古技艺重铸失传的 Tenno 刀刃，使侍刃武士刀重新展现。

descriptions.en: With heightened agility and power the Kestrel Prime's heavy attacks easily knock down foes, ensuring none shall stand before it.
descriptions.zh: （英文：KESTREL PRIME）凭借更高的敏捷性和力量，红隼 Prime 的重击可以轻松击倒敌人，所向披靡。

descriptions.en: The Obex system multiplies the kinetic energy of a Tenno's kicks and punches, delivering devastating blows to any target.
descriptions.zh: （英文：OBEX）奥比克斯战斗系统能强化 Tenno 的近身肉搏能力，给予目标致命伤害。

descriptions.en: Ring a funeral toll upon enemy skulls with Harrow Prime's signature pistol.
descriptions.zh: （英文：KNELL PRIME）用 Harrow Prime 的标志性手枪在敌人的头颅上敲响葬礼的钟声。

descriptions.en: These coverings for the hands and feet allow devastating high flying hand-to-hand combat attacks without risking harm to the user.
descriptions.zh: （英文：KOGAKE）这些覆盖物装在使用者的手脚上，能让他们进行激烈又危险的肉搏战而不受到伤害。

descriptions.en: Deliver a golden knockout with these prime Melee Weapons.
descriptions.zh: （英文：KOGAKE PRIME）用这副 Prime 近战武器打出金色的击倒。

descriptions.en: Glinting like a golden dawn, Yareli Prime’s signature pistol engulfs foes in a cascade of virulent, explosive, water globules. None can escape the sea.
descriptions.zh: （英文：KOMPRESSA PRIME）Yareli Prime 的标志性手枪闪耀着金色黎明般的光芒，将敌人吞噬在一连串的剧毒、爆炸性水弹中。没有人能逃出这片水域。

descriptions.en: Ancient blades, perfected for today’s combat.
descriptions.zh: （英文：KRONEN PRIME）远古之刃，但完美契合今日的战斗。

descriptions.en: Kunai throwing daggers offer a silent alternative to the traditional side arm. Perfect for assassins.
descriptions.zh: （英文：KUNAI）苦无以投掷用匕首替代传统次要武器的非静音攻击。暗杀首选。

descriptions.en: Sweep aside hordes of enemies with flaming fury of this powerful, automatic, grenade launching archgun.
descriptions.zh: （英文：KUVA AYANGA）用这款全自动曲翼榴弹发射器的怒火来扫荡大群敌人。

descriptions.en: Detonate heads with this slow-firing rifle that rewards precision.
descriptions.zh: （英文：KUVA CHAKKHURR）用这款需要精确瞄准的低射速步枪来打爆敌人的头颅。

descriptions.en: A crushing, killing, rocket-powered stab-hammer. Grineer, naturally.
descriptions.zh: （英文：KUVA SHILDEG）一款以碾碎与杀戮为卖点的火箭动力刺锤。这显然是 Grineer 的杰作。

descriptions.en: This Lich-variant semi-automatic hand cannon delivers a lot of punch in a small package. Higher fire rate, magazine capacity and reload speed.
descriptions.zh: （英文：KUVA BRAKK）这把玄骸变体的半自动手枪，小型的枪身中却拥有强大的冲击力。它拥有更高的射速、更大的弹匣容量以及更快的装填速度

descriptions.en: The Kuva Drakgoon flak cannon sends volleys of intensely hot shrapnel ricocheting around the room that do not slow down. Larger Magazine Capacity and Reload Speed. Can be fired in wide or concentrated bursts.
descriptions.zh: （英文：KUVA DRAKGOON）这款改造版龙骑兵破片炮可击发出会四处弹射且不会减速的高热弹片。它拥有更大的弹匣容量和更快的装填速度。能以散射或压缩集中的方式进行射击。

descriptions.en: The addition of Kuva has forged the savage Ghoulsaw into an even more brutal weapon, allowing for faster attacks.
descriptions.zh: （英文：KUVA GHOULSAW）赤毒将尸鬼电锯锻造成了更野蛮的武器，可以进行更快的攻击。

descriptions.en: Reconfigured for maximum lethality, the Kuva Grattler still shatters targets with explosive shells, but now reaches maximum fire-rate instantaneously.
descriptions.zh: （英文：KUVA GRATTLER）重新调配以获得最大杀伤力，赤毒葛拉特勒仍使用爆裂弹来粉碎目标，但现在可以瞬间达到最高射速。

descriptions.en: This Grineer bow delivers vengeance in the form of clusterbomb-tipped arrows that can be detonated mid-air or on impact. Low quiver capacity, arrows are recovered singly.
descriptions.zh: （英文：KUVA BRAMMA）这把 Grineer 弓箭能射出尖端配有集束炸弹的复仇箭矢，可以在空中或遇到冲击时引爆。低箭袋容量，箭矢逐个恢复。

descriptions.en: Forged at the behest of the Worm Queen herself, this already powerful shotgun now has the additional ability to fire from all four barrels simultaneously.
descriptions.zh: （英文：KUVA HEK）蠕虫女皇亲自下令锻造这把本就十分强大的霰弹枪，拥有额外功能可以同时从全部四个枪管开火。

descriptions.en: This powerful Grineer burst rifle has been retrofitted to add semi-automatic and automatic fire modes.
descriptions.zh: （英文：KUVA HIND）这款强大的 Grineer 连射步枪经过改装，增加了半自动和全自动开火模式。

descriptions.en: The custom weapon of a fearsome Kuva Lich. It has greater reload speed, lower recoil and greater accuracy than the standard-issue Karak rifle.
descriptions.zh: （英文：KUVA KARAK）某位可怕的赤毒玄骸所使用的改装武器。相比于原版卡拉克步枪，它拥有更快的装填速度、更低的后座力以及更高的精准度。

descriptions.en: The Kuva Kohm variant has a higher fire rate than the original. For every shot fired in rapid succession the Kuva Kohm releases an additional bolt and grows more lethal.
descriptions.zh: （英文：KUVA KOHM ）这把赤毒寇恩热能枪变体拥有比原版更高的射速。赤毒寇恩热能枪在每一次高速连续的射击时都会额外击发出一发能量弹，使其更具杀伤力。

descriptions.en: A custom variant that fires three quick shots with a single pull of the trigger, or can alt-fire burst the remainder of its magazine. Higher Fire Rate, Magazine Capacity and Reload Speed.
descriptions.zh: （英文：KUVA KRAKEN）一种北海巨妖的改装变体，单扣扳机可迅速击出三连发射击，或者可通过次要射击来进行点射。它拥有更高的射速、更大的弹匣容量以及更快的装填速度

descriptions.en: A highly-optimized Nukor that allows for the weapon’s microwave field to hit up to two additional targets.
descriptions.zh: （英文：KUVA NUKOR）一把高度优化的努寇微波枪，可以通过其微波场击中最多两个额外目标。

descriptions.en: The custom weapon of a fearsome Kuva Lich. Unlike the basic version the Kuva Ogris fires detonite-infused casings semi-automatically, from a smaller magazine, while dealing greater damage per shot.
descriptions.zh: （英文：KUVA OGRIS）某位可怕的赤毒玄骸所使用的改装武器。与原版不同，它拥有更小的弹匣，能以半自动的方式发射满载易爆物的炮弹，同时每一发能造成更多伤害。

descriptions.en: Unlike a standard Quartakk this Kuva Lich variant fires automatically from the hip while retaining its signature feature when aimed: annihilating targets with four simultaneous shots.
descriptions.zh: （英文：KUVA QUARTAKK）与原版夸塔克不同，这种赤毒玄骸夸塔克变体能从腰际全自动开火射击，同时保持了瞄准时的特点：用 4 发同步射击来消灭目标。

descriptions.en: This variant pistol has higher fire rate and magazine capacity. Superior zoom capabilities plus projectiles have a small Corrosive burst.
descriptions.zh: （英文：KUVA SEER）这把变体手枪拥有更高的射速、弹匣容量以及变焦倍率。此外，它射出的子弹还会产生小范围腐蚀爆炸效果。

descriptions.en: The Kuva Sobek's exceptional Reload Speed, Critical Chance, and Status Chance make it a natural fit for the Kuva Lich's dominant spirit.
descriptions.zh: （英文：KUVA SOBEK）赤毒·鳄神出色的装填速度、暴击几率和触发几率，与赤毒玄骸的霸道风格高度契合。

descriptions.en: Double-fist rapid-fire bursts of pain with these dual-wield variants of the Grineer submachine gun. Higher Fire Rate and Magazine Capacity.
descriptions.zh: （英文：KUVA TWIN STUBBAS）用这把 Grineer 冲锋枪双持变体的爆发速射特性来产生双倍的苦痛。它拥有更高的射速和更大的弹匣容量。

descriptions.en: This Lich-variant grenade launcher hurls mayhem and destruction with an increased Reload Speed.
descriptions.zh: （英文：KUVA TONKOR）这种榴弹发射器玄骸变体拥有更快的装填速度，可以对敌人猛烈射出暴乱与破坏。

descriptions.en: An even stronger Zarr cannon to meet the demands of Kuva Liches. With stronger explosive barrages, and long-range flak shots.
descriptions.zh: （英文：KUVA ZARR）一把更强大的沙皇火炮，满足了赤毒玄骸的需求。拥有更强的爆裂弹幕和更远距离的高射炮弹。

descriptions.en: Embrace pandemonium. Chainfire and explosive potential meet in Larkspur Prime. Hildryn packs more ammo when she wields this mighty weapon.
descriptions.zh: （英文：LARKSPUR PRIME）迎接混乱的到来吧。连锁攻击和爆炸潜能在翠雀 Prime 身上相遇。当 Hildryn 使用这件强大的武器时，她会携带更多的弹药。

descriptions.en: Perforate Techrot, and anyone else who stands in your way, with this Scaldra machine gun. Alternative fire pummels targets with Efervon laced buckshot.
descriptions.zh: （英文：EFV-5 JUPITER）使用这把炽蛇军机枪扫射科腐者和任何胆敢阻挡你的人。次要射击使用涂有艾弗旺的霰弹重击目标。

descriptions.en: The standard issue personal Efervon projector, as sported by all ranks of Scaldra.
descriptions.zh: （英文：EFV-8 MARS）标准的单兵艾弗旺喷射器，各个军衔的炽蛇军都配有此武器。

descriptions.en: Reap what the Techrot have sown with this vicious pair of Scaldra hand-scythes.
descriptions.zh: （英文：DUAL VICISS）用这对凶恶的炽蛇军镰刀来收获科腐者所播种的恶果。

descriptions.en: A true masterpiece of Höllvanian engineering, Vesper 77's advanced laser sight highlights enemy Weak Points with precision. Aim to increase its Critical Damage Multiplier.
descriptions.zh: （英文：VESPER 77）夜语者 77 是霍瓦尼亚工程的真正杰作，其先进的激光瞄准器可突出显示敌人的弱点。瞄准来提高其暴击伤害倍率。

descriptions.en: Put them down so that they stay down, with this Scaldra slug launcher.
descriptions.zh: （英文：PURGATOR 1）用这把炽蛇军武器让敌人再起不能。

descriptions.en: The Lato is a highly accurate pistol used by the Tenno everywhere.
descriptions.zh: （英文：LATO）拉托是一款被 Tenno 广泛使用的高精度手枪。

descriptions.en: A special version of the standard Lato pistol with a slower Fire Rate but offering higher Accuracy and Damage values. The Lato Vandal has been customized by the Tenno with a blue-green metallic finish and Lotus branding on the grips.
descriptions.zh: （英文：LATO VANDAL）拉托的特别版，射速略低但伤害和精准度更高。拉托·破坏者被 Tenno 定制成蓝绿色金属光泽，并在握把上绘制了 Lotus 纹样。

descriptions.en: The Latron is a highly efficient rifle that performs well at medium and at long range, its accuracy making it a deadly weapon in the hands of skilled marksmen.
descriptions.zh: （英文：LATRON）拉特昂是一支半自动步枪。其高性能和高准确性令它在一名能精准射击的人手中时可以变得十分致命。

descriptions.en: The ornamental Latron Prime exploits ancient Orokin technology to get a slight damage increase over the standard Latron.
descriptions.zh: （英文：LATRON PRIME）这把经过装饰的拉特昂 Prime 利用了远古的奥罗金技术，拥有比标准版拉特昂还高的伤害。

descriptions.en: The Latron Wraith is a powerful variation of the standard, semi-automatic rifle that features unique styling.
descriptions.zh: （英文：LATRON WRAITH）拉特昂·亡魂是把变异版本的半自动步枪，拥有强大火力以及自己的独特外观。

descriptions.en: Custom variant of a Corpus classic. Staggering blasts now ricochet and have greater range at the cost of a slower fire and reload speed. Surviving enemies are consumed with radiation.
descriptions.zh: （英文：TENET ARCA PLASMOR）Corpus 经典武器的特制变体。惊人的爆炸会反弹且拥有更高的射程，但代价是更低的射速和装填速度。幸存下来的敌人会被辐射耗尽生命。

descriptions.en: This reengineered Cycron features a refracting energy disc that can split off the main target, hitting up to 2 additional nearby targets.
descriptions.zh: （英文：TENET CYCRON）这款重新设计的循环离子枪拥有一个折射能量盘，光束射击可以从主要目标上分离，最多击中附近的两个额外目标。

descriptions.en: Parvos Granum's engineers have made this already ferocious hand cannon even more deadly with the addition of an alternate fire mode that empties an entire clip in one devastating burst.
descriptions.zh: （英文：TENET DETRON）帕尔沃斯·格拉努的工程师们为这把已经十分凶猛的手炮增加了一种新的射击模式，在一次毁灭性的爆发中清空整个弹匣，使这把武器更加致命。

descriptions.en: The expert engineers in Parvos Granum’s division have optimized the Ferrox’s lethal power.
descriptions.zh: （英文：TENET FERROX）帕尔沃斯·格拉努部门的专业工程师优化了铁晶磁轨炮的杀伤力。

descriptions.en: Sister-modified Flux Rifle with increased fire rate and range. Recharge has been replaced with ammo clips to accommodate greater power needs.
descriptions.zh: （英文：TENET FLUX RIFLE）由姐妹们改装过的通量步枪提升了射速和射程。充电系统已被弹匣取代以适应更高的电量消耗。

descriptions.en: Advances in microelectronics have improved a Corpus classic. Tenet Glaxion’s photon beam strikes up to four enemies at once. It also boasts superior Damage, Critical Chance, and Status Chance.
descriptions.zh: （英文：TENET GLAXION）微电子技术的进步改进了 Corpus 的经典武器。信条·冷冻光束步枪的光子束最多可以同时攻击四个敌人。它还拥有较高的伤害、暴击几率和触发几率。

descriptions.en: Alternate fire on this reengineered Plinx fires a projectile that pulls enemies close and then explodes. Its cooldown increases after the explosion to accommodate battery power demands.
descriptions.zh: （英文：TENET PLINX）这把重新设计的漫射者可以使用次要射击发射一枚投射物将敌人拉近然后爆炸。爆炸后冷却时间会增加以满足电池的电量需求。

descriptions.en: Once a mining tool adapted for military purposes, Parvosian engineering has enhanced the Quanta's lethality even further.
descriptions.zh: （英文：Tenet Quanta）曾经的采矿工具为了军事用途而改造，帕尔沃斯式的工程技术进一步增强了量子切割器的杀伤力。

descriptions.en: Parvosian upgrade of the classic Tetra. Slower fire rate but with a larger magazine. Can now alt-fire entire clip as a large burst radius grenade launcher.
descriptions.zh: （英文：TENET TETRA）经典特拉的帕尔沃斯式升级版。射速较慢但拥有更大的弹匣。次要射击可以将整个弹匣作为高爆炸范围的榴弹发射出去。

descriptions.en: Itemize and execute with this pair of auto-lock-on, homing-projectile pistols. Shoot from-hip for a more conventional pistol experience. The patented Granum Attaché System reloads the pistols when holstered.
descriptions.zh: （英文：TENET DIPLOS）用这对自动锁定追踪目标的双枪将敌人逐个击破。腰射模式与传统手枪无异。配备了获得专利批准的格拉努公文包系统，收起时自动装填。

descriptions.en: This discreet rocket launcher is equally at home in a board meeting or on a casual outing. Aimed rockets are wire-guided for greater accuracy, but travel more slowly. The patented Granum Attaché System reloads the weapon when holstered.
descriptions.zh: （英文：TENET ENVOY）这款朴素的火箭发射器在董事会会议或休闲郊游时同样适用。瞄准发射的火箭是线导的，精确度更高，但飞行速度更慢。配备了获得专利批准的格拉努公文包系统，收起时自动装填。

descriptions.en: On Heavy Slide Attack, this Corpus scythe launches a spinning energy disk that ricochets throughout the battlefield. Its lifetime is derived from the size of the Combo Counter. Note: The Granum Attaché system pauses the combo timer when holstered.
descriptions.zh: （英文：TENET GRIGORI）滑行重击时，这把 Corpus 镰刀会发射一个旋转的能量盘在战场上弹跳。能量盘的持续时间由近战连击数决定。注意：格拉努公文包系统会在武器收起时暂停连击倒计时。

descriptions.en: Dominate rivals with this pistol’s lightning fast rail-slugs. Head-shots speed up reload.
descriptions.zh: （英文：TENET SPIREX）用这把手枪快如闪电的弹道压制对手。爆头可加快装填速度。

descriptions.en: The Lex Prime is a powerful, accurate pistol that has a low Fire Rate and Magazine Capacity. Very efficient at long range.
descriptions.zh: （英文：LEX PRIME）雷克斯 Prime 是一把强大且精准的手枪，虽然有着射速慢和弹匣小的缺点，但在远距离作战时非常出色。

descriptions.en: A flash of red ribbon is the last thing most victims of these throwing-daggers see.
descriptions.zh: （英文：SPIRA）彤红缎带的残影，是这款投掷匕首刃下大多数受害者最后看到的影像。

descriptions.en: The Dragon Nikana is forged from ancient Tenno steel. This is a master's weapon, only the most worthy of Tenno may wield it.
descriptions.zh: （英文：DRAGON NIKANA）龙之侍刃是以古代 Tenno 特制的钢铁所铸成。这是大师的武器，只有武艺修为能与之相配的 Tenno 能使用它。

descriptions.en: A ferocious Melee Weapon crafted by the Grineer and carried by their elite melee forces.
descriptions.zh: （英文：MACHETE）Grineer 制造的一把凶猛近战兵器，多数由精锐力量携带。

descriptions.en: The versatile Magnus revolver is a lethal sidearm for any Tenno.
descriptions.zh: （英文：MAGNUS）多功能麦格努斯左轮手枪对于任何 Tenno 来说都是一把能置对手于死地的手枪。

descriptions.en: Orokin elegance meets formidable stopping power in this exquisite revolver. Hits have a chance to maximize Ammo Efficiency for a few seconds.
descriptions.zh: （英文：MAGNUS PRIME）奥罗金的优雅与强大制动力在这把精致的左轮手枪中相遇。命中时有几率在数秒内最大化弹药效率。

descriptions.en: A greatsword for those with an insatiable hunger for victory. Grendel is immune to crowd-control when he performs Heavy Attacks with this weapon.
descriptions.zh: （英文：MASSETER PRIME）为那些渴求胜利的人所打造巨剑。当 Grendel 使用这把武器进行重击时，他能够免疫群体控制技能。

descriptions.en: A relic from the Great Plague, the Mire Infested Sword is a brutal weapon. It not only cuts into the enemy, it infects the wounds of its victim with a toxic nerve poison. Deals <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin Damage on Ground Slam attacks.
descriptions.zh: （英文：MIRE）米尔感染之剑是一柄来自「大瘟疫」时期的残暴武器。不仅能切开敌人，更能在其伤口染上神经剧毒。此外，米尔在震地攻击时会造成 <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素伤害。

descriptions.en: The Miter launches high velocity saw blades, tearing apart anyone unfortunate enough to be in their path.
descriptions.zh: （英文：MITER）米特尔发射高速锯片，撕裂任何不幸在其路径上的人。

descriptions.en: Take active defense to new heights with this deadly flying shield and brutal blade. Throw the shield with a unique Heavy Attack, inflicting Blast Status Effects and dealing damage in a wide area.
descriptions.zh: （英文：TAK & LUG）这套残暴而致命的剑盾组合完美展示了最好的防守就是进攻。通过独特的重击可投掷出盾牌，造成爆炸异常状态和大范围伤害。

descriptions.en: The sword the fabled Orokin executioner Nihil used to glass the condemned. Swing while Aim Gliding to glass enemies. A Ground Slam will smash nearby glassed foes, while sending forward a narrow shockwave to shatter distant ones. A Heavy Slam sends forth a wider shockwave with greater force.
descriptions.zh: （英文：VITRICA）传说中的奥罗金行刑者无刹，用这把剑来将犯人玻璃化。在飞身瞄准时挥动攻击可以使敌人玻璃化。震地攻击将击碎附近玻璃化的敌人，同时向前放出一道冲击窄波，来击碎远处的敌人。重型震地攻击则会放出威力更大且更宽的冲击波。

descriptions.en: A golden version of Garuda's versatile crossbow, as fashioned by the Orokin's finest weaponsmiths. Alt-fire to let loose a barrage of bolts. All bolts have a chance to cause <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status, and Headshot kills have a chance to increase Reload Speed. When wielded by Garuda the Nagantaka gains a slight Punch Through.
descriptions.zh: （英文：NAGANTAKA PRIME）Garuda 的标志性十字弓的镀金版本，由奥罗金最优秀的工匠所锻造。次要射击能发射出弩矢弹幕；每支弩矢都有可能造成 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割异常状态，爆头击杀则可加快装填速度。在被 Garuda 使用时，噬蛇弩会获得少量的穿透效果。

descriptions.en: Roll Koumei's die with every 30 hits from Amanata to empower yourself with 1 of 5 Koumei blessings. Roll a 6 to receive all blessings at once.
descriptions.zh: （英文：AMANATA）天薙刀每命中敌人 30 次，就掷一次 Koumei 的骰子。掷出 1 到 5 的结果各赋予一种增益，而掷出 6 则一次性赋予所有增益。

descriptions.en: The dual flaming fang-blades of the Archon Amar. Has a unique Neutral Combo that blasts out four short-range fireballs.
descriptions.zh: （英文：NEPHERI）执刑官欺谋狼主的烈焰双刃。其独特的近战组合可以发射四个短程火球。

descriptions.en: Archon Boreal’s signature trident. Thrust Korumm into the ground with a Tactical Combo and then rip it out in a shower of electricity.
descriptions.zh: （英文：KORUMM）执刑官诡文枭主的标志性三叉戟。战术组合可以将雷霆暴君插入地面，并在拔出时造成电击。

descriptions.en: Archon Nira’s spine-shattering whip. Has a unique Tactical Combo that whips out a wide wave of energy with each stroke.
descriptions.zh: （英文：VERDILAC）执刑官混沌蛇主的刺骨长鞭。其独特的战术组合每次抽击时都会掀起巨大的能量波。

descriptions.en: Caliban’s signature scythe, forged from a limb wrenched off a fallen Eidolon centuries ago. 50% increased Melee Combo Counter Chance when wielded by Caliban.
descriptions.zh: （英文：VENATO）Caliban 的标志性镰刀，由几个世纪前从一个倒下的夜灵身上扯下的肢体锻造而成。被 Caliban 挥舞时，有 50% 几率获得额外近战连击数。

descriptions.en: An ancient weapon imbued with a new truth.
descriptions.zh: （英文：NINKONDI PRIME）一把注入了新真理的古老武器。

descriptions.en: Nokko’s signature archgun fires six homing missiles, each bearing a payload of one of the six combined elements which detonate in an area upon impact.
descriptions.zh: （英文：ARBUCEP）Nokko 的标志性曲翼枪械可发射六枚追踪导弹，每枚导弹都运载着六种组合元素之一，命中时会在区域内引爆。

descriptions.en: With its lightning-fast strikes, the Ninkondi pays respect to the old ways.
descriptions.zh: （英文：NINKONDI）这把降灵追猎者凭借其迅如闪电的打击，充分体现了古老的战斗形式。

descriptions.en: Enforce authority with these fine-edged sai blades.
descriptions.zh: （英文：OKINA PRIME）通过这些精细的双叉锋刃彰显权力。

descriptions.en: Forged for veterans of the Scarlet Spear conflict, this Lacera has been modified to enhance nimbleness and lethality.
descriptions.zh: （英文：CETI LACERA）这款专为参与猩红之矛战役的老将所打造的悲痛之刃，经过了改造以提高敏捷性和杀伤力。

descriptions.en: The wrath of one who knows revenge is all about timing. Orion's signature Heavy Scythe.
descriptions.zh: （英文：WRATH）复仇之道，重在时机，此为深谙此语之人的怒火。Orion 的标志性重型镰刀。

descriptions.en: Baruuk's signature weapons: a sword for retribution, a shield for restraint. In Baruuk's hands, and his hands only, Cobra's first strike in a combo renders his foe unconscious.
descriptions.zh: （英文：COBRA & CRANE）Baruuk 的标志性武器：代表报应的剑，以及象征克制的盾。唯有在 Baruuk 的手中，眼镜蛇招式中的第一次打击可使敌人失去意识。

descriptions.en: The Magistar mace wields justice and truth in the form of bone-crushing blows.
descriptions.zh: （英文：MAGISTAR）执法者钉锤以碎骨般的打击来执掌正义与真理。

descriptions.en: Pound the beat for a dance of death with Octavia's signature prime pistol.
descriptions.zh: （英文：PANDERO PRIME）以这把 Octavia 的标志性 Prime 手枪，为死亡之舞敲奏节拍。

descriptions.en: A classic Tenno blade, beautifully reimagined.
descriptions.zh: （英文：PANGOLIN PRIME）Tenno 的经典剑刃，经过精美重制。

descriptions.en: A unique blade used by an old Tenno clan.
descriptions.zh: （英文：PANGOLIN SWORD）古老 Tenno 氏族所使用的独特刀刃​​。

descriptions.en: The max-velocity saw-launcher perfected. Features a larger magazine, faster fire rate, and a radial, slashing ricochet.
descriptions.zh: （英文：PANTHERA PRIME）完美打造的极速锯片发射器。具有更大的弹匣、更快的射速，以及可在一定范围内弹跳的锋利锯片。

descriptions.en: Reap havoc with this full sized Tenno-crafted scythe.
descriptions.zh: （英文：ANKU）带来毁灭与收割生命的制式规格镰刀，由 Tenno 所锻造。

descriptions.en: Kullervo's signature weapon boasts melee synergy. Every shot that lands increases the wielder's Melee Combo count. When Kullervo wields Rauta, it also increases his Melee Combo duration.
descriptions.zh: （英文：RAUTA）Kullervo 的标志性武器具有近战协同的优势。每次命中都会增加持枪者的近战连击数。当 Kullervo 使用锐铁时，它也会增加他的近战连击持续时间。

descriptions.en: The one who exalted Voruna to her Prime form imbued her signature sniper rifle with increased magazine size and ammo capacity, as if to arm her for a long hunt.
descriptions.zh: （英文：PERIGAL PRIME）将 Voruna 提升到 Prime 状态的人，也提升了她的标志性狙击步枪，增加了弹匣容量和弹药容量，仿佛是要让她做好长时间狩猎的准备。

descriptions.en: Phantasma Prime is burnished with deadly force. In Revenant’s hands, it has increased magazine capacity. The might of its irradiated plasma is reminiscent of the fearsome Eidolon.
descriptions.zh: （英文：PHANTASMA PRIME）幻离子 Prime 由死亡之力打磨而成。它在 Revenant 的手中，会拥有更多的弹匣容量。它的等离子照射光束所发出的威力，会让人不禁想起那令人生畏的夜灵。

descriptions.en: An advanced blade that delivers high-damage attacks. Delivers a high percentage of critical strikes.
descriptions.zh: （英文：PLASMA SWORD）这是一把先进的武器，有着高蓄力伤害和暴击几率。

descriptions.en: The Tenno forged Orthos is a rare double bladed polearm. Those who take the time to master it speak of its impressive striking distance and ability to hit multiple targets.
descriptions.zh: （英文：ORTHOS）由 Tenno 所铸造的欧特鲁斯是把罕见的双刃长矛。对于投入时间掌握这把武器的人们总会谈起它令人印象深刻的攻击距离与群击能力。

descriptions.en: Orthos Prime is an ancient Orokin martial weapon, forged from the purest Rubedo making it extremely light-weight.
descriptions.zh: （英文：ORTHOS PRIME）作为上古奥罗金的军用武器，欧特鲁斯 Prime 由最纯净的红化结晶制成，因而极其轻盈。

descriptions.en: Banshee Prime's signature shotgun is an instrument of devastation that fires both focused and broad shots.
descriptions.zh: （英文：EUPHONA PRIME）Banshee Prime 的标志性霰弹枪是把可射出集中和散射子弹的破坏性武器。

descriptions.en: The beauty of this luxuriously gilded crossbow cannot obscure its lethal purpose.
descriptions.zh: （英文：BALLISTICA PRIME）这款豪华镀金连弩的精美无法遮掩它致命的目的。

descriptions.en: A classic Orokin weapon, Bo Prime creates elegant fury on the battlefield.
descriptions.zh: （英文：BO PRIME）一把经典奥罗金兵器，使用它以优雅的战姿横扫战场。

descriptions.en: A noble bow to hunt hellish beasts.
descriptions.zh: （英文：CERNOS PRIME）一把用来狩猎恶兽的高贵之弓。

descriptions.en: The Dakra Prime is a Tenno forged weapon, crafted during the time of the Orokin. It is renowned for speed, power and the ability to hit multiple targets.
descriptions.zh: （英文：DAKRA PRIME）达克拉 Prime 是一把由 Tenno 锻造的武器，在奥罗金时代被制作出来，并且以其速度，威力跟多目标打击的能力著名。

descriptions.en: Long believed lost, the mighty Daikyu Prime was the pride of many a Tenno dojo. Designed to strike the foe where they are weakest, its powerful shots repay careful marksmanship.
descriptions.zh: （英文：DAIKYU PRIME）长久以来，人们一直认为强大的大久和弓 Prime 早已失传，它是许多 Tenno 道场的骄傲。它旨在直击敌人的弱点，其强大的射击威力与精湛的射击技术相得益彰。

descriptions.en: The sensual lines of these golden Kamas have long been celebrated as a masterwork of Tenno weapon smithing.
descriptions.zh: （英文：DUAL KAMAS PRIME）这对拥有迷人线条的金色短柄战镰，长久以来一直被奉为 Tenno 武器锻造的杰作。

descriptions.en: Only Tenno were strong enough to wield this noble beast of a weapon.
descriptions.zh: （英文：GALATINE PRIME）只有 Tenno 才足以运用这把高尚野兽般的武器。

descriptions.en: As deadly as any bullet without the associated noise or commotion.
descriptions.zh: （英文：HIKOU PRIME）如同任何子弹一样致命，且不会引起噪音或骚动。

descriptions.en: These rare, braided throwing daggers were a favorite tool of high ranking Orokin assassins.
descriptions.zh: （英文：SPIRA PRIME）配置这些罕见的投掷匕首，是奥罗金高阶刺客喜欢的工具。

descriptions.en: Caliban Prime's signature sniper rifle is no mere ceremonial weapon. A sign, perhaps, that peace between Orokin and Sentient was destined to be fleeting. Struck enemies become lightning rods, with a chance to attract bolts of chain lightning that can jump to nearby enemies.
descriptions.zh: （英文：VADARYA PRIME）Caliban Prime 的标志性狙击步枪并非仅仅是仪式武器。它或许预示着奥罗金与 Sentient 之间的和平注定转瞬即逝。被击中的敌人会变成避雷针，有几率吸引连锁闪电，这些闪电会跳跃到附近的敌人身上。

descriptions.en: Forged by a forgotten master, these exquisite blades are bounty from a golden-age long gone.
descriptions.zh: （英文：NAMI SKYLA PRIME）由一位被遗忘的大师所锻造，这对精致的刀刃是来自那早已消失的黄金时代的财宝。

descriptions.en: An ancient blade predating the fall of the Orokin Empire. Forged using techniques lost over the centuries, the edge remains sharper than that of any modern Nikana.
descriptions.zh: （英文：NIKANA PRIME）远在奥罗金帝国灭亡之前即存在的古老刀刃。以失落的技术所锻冶之刀锋，至今仍比当代各型侍刃来的锐利。

descriptions.en: An ancient executioners weapon, the honor of decapitation by the Scindo Prime was reserved for the Orokin's most respected enemies.
descriptions.zh: （英文：SCINDO PRIME）一把古老的刑具，只有那些最受奥罗金尊重的敌人才能享有被分裂斩斧 Prime 斩首的荣耀。

descriptions.en: Reaper Prime is an ornamental scythe, with a blade forged from tempered Rubedo.
descriptions.zh: （英文：REAPER PRIME）收割者 Prime 是一把装饰用镰刀，带有以回火工艺处理过的红化结晶锻造的刀刃。

descriptions.en: An artifact of exquisite beauty. A weapon of deadly purpose.
descriptions.zh: （英文：TIGRIS PRIME）既是精美的工艺品，也是致命的武器。

descriptions.en: Gleaming blades of white draw blood of the deepest red.
descriptions.zh: （英文：VENKA PRIME）拥有剃刀般切开敌人的锐利爪子。

descriptions.en: With a high fire rate, ammo efficiency and rapid reload when emptied, this unusual sidearm can hand out carnage all day long. Ammo efficiency is further increased when Protea uses this, her signature weapon.
descriptions.zh: （英文：VELOX）在高射速、高弹药效率以及高装填速度的加持下，这把非比寻常的次要武器能昼夜无休地大杀四方。作为 Protea 的标志性武器，弹药效率会在 Protea 使用它时更进一步地提升。

descriptions.en: Three kills in rapid succession to summon a second ethereal Pyrana for twice the deadly punch.
descriptions.zh: （英文：PYRANA PRIME）快速地连续 3 次击杀将召唤一把食人鱼的幻影，造成双倍的致命杀伤。

descriptions.en: The Hek is a powerful shotgun that fires its shots with a tight spread, making it efficient at medium range as long as its strong recoil is properly managed.
descriptions.zh: （英文：HEK）海克是一把能发射密集弹丸的强力霰弹枪，只要能驾驭其猛烈后坐力，在中距离战斗也能有效发挥。

descriptions.en: Wield Xaku Prime’s elegant fan, its gilded edges crafted for both precision and prestige.
descriptions.zh: （英文：QUASSUS PRIME）挥舞着 Xaku Prime 的优雅扇子，它的镀金边缘尽显精密与尊贵。

descriptions.en: Heat, cold, electricity, or toxin: choose an element and launch a flurry of deadly quills. This versatile sidearm is Khora’s signature weapon and has a chance to instantly reload after headshots when she wields it.
descriptions.zh: （英文：HYSTRIX）火焰、冰冻、电击或者毒素：选择一种元素并发射出一簇簇致命的刺镖。这款灵活多变的次要武器是 Khora 的标志性武器。当她使用豪猪时，爆头有几率使弹药重新装填。

descriptions.en: Tear through any target with these vicious, claw-like blades. The signature swords of Khora.
descriptions.zh: （英文：DUAL KERES）用这恶毒的爪状刀片撕开任何目标。Khora 的标志性刀剑。

descriptions.en: The Quellor was standard-issue to Dax Railjack crews of the Old War, dating back to the earliest, pre-Sigma craft. A rapid-fire assault rifle with a hefty magazine-size, the Quellor is an all-round workhorse. Also capable of large, short-range cryo-blasts.
descriptions.zh: （英文：QUELLOR）压制者是远古之战时禁卫航道星舰舰员的标准配置武器，其最早的铸造可追溯到西格玛系列之前。这是一种速射突击步枪，拥有较大的弹匣容量，是全能型的主战武器。而且也有着巨大的、短距离的冰冻冲击。

descriptions.en: Designed to quickly vaporize minerals for content analysis, users discovered its powerful beam was equally efficient at dispatching hostiles.
descriptions.zh: （英文：GAMMACOR）原为使矿物迅速蒸发以便于分析作业而设计，然而使用者却发现它强大的光束对于终结敌人也同样有效。

descriptions.en: Deal double-bladed, double-barreled death with this primed gunblade.
descriptions.zh: （英文：REDEEMER PRIME）以这把 Prime 枪刃制造出双重刀刃、双重口径伤口的死亡。

descriptions.en: Irradiate enemies with a continuous stream of deadly plasma. Charging secondary fire releases a glob of plasma that erupts with homing bomblets on impact. Increased Magazine Capacity when wielded by Revenant.
descriptions.zh: （英文：PHANTASMA）用连续的致命等离子束照射敌人；次要攻击充能后可以释放出一团等离子球，球体碰撞时会产生多发制导的小型炸弹。在被 Revenant 使用时，该武器的弹匣容量会提升。

descriptions.en: Steady and reliable, the Vasto revolver combines speed and power for a classic gunslinger feel.
descriptions.zh: （英文：VASTO）稳定、可靠。这把瓦斯托左轮手枪结合了速度与力量，呈现出经典的神枪手意象。

descriptions.en: For the hunter, the apex of the sniper's art. For the hunted, a gateway to the next life.
descriptions.zh: （英文：RUBICO PRIME）对猎人而言，这是狙击艺术的巅峰。对于猎物而言，这是通向来生的大门。

descriptions.en: The sidearm of choice for Prime Grineer warriors, Sagek Prime blends Grineer brutality with Orokin aesthetics. When Sagek Prime inflicts a critical hit, its next shot has a chance to gain significant Status Chance.
descriptions.zh: （英文：SAGEK PRIME）作为精英 Grineer 战士的首选次要武器，杀格 Prime 融合了 Grineer 的残暴和 Orokin 的美学。当杀格 Prime 造成暴击时，其下一次射击有几率大幅提升触发几率。

descriptions.en: Bombard legions of enemies with target seeking rockets. These dual launchers reload faster while sprinting, even more so in Gauss’ hands. Rockets arm after reaching a safe distance.
descriptions.zh: （英文：AKARIUS）使用目标追踪火箭弹轰击成群的敌人。冲刺时可以更快地装填弹匣，在 Gauss 手里效果更加显著。火箭会在离开安全距离后爆炸。

descriptions.en: Using a barrage of rapid-fire plasma rockets, Gauss’ signature weapon lays down a path of destruction. Reloads are faster while sprinting, even more so in Gauss’ hands. For safety, rockets arm after traveling a safe distance.
descriptions.zh: （英文：ACCELTRA）通过使用速射电浆火箭弹，Gauss 的标志性武器铺设了一条毁灭之路。冲刺时可以更快地装填弹匣，在 Gauss 手里效果更加显著。为了安全起见，火箭会在离开安全距离后爆炸。

descriptions.en: Voruna Prime's signature axe is adorned with Orokin gold. She personally ensured that the former owners would have no further use for it.
descriptions.zh: （英文：SAROFANG PRIME）Voruna Prime 的标志性战斧装饰着奥罗金黄金。她亲自确保了这把战斧的前任主人不会再使用它。

descriptions.en: Smite the unrighteous with Harrow Prime's signature speargun.
descriptions.zh: （英文：SCOURGE PRIME）用 Harrow Prime 的标志性标枪打击不义之徒。

descriptions.en: Go on the hunt with Oraxia’s signature secondary. Fling a volley of toxin-laced barbs, or drop a cluster snare that scatters on impact, seizing nearby enemies and dragging them together.
descriptions.zh: （英文：SCYOTID）使用 Oraxia 的标志性次要武器进行狩猎。你可以射出一连串充满毒素的倒钩，或者投放一个在撞击时散开的团状陷阱，抓住附近的敌人并将其拖到一起。

descriptions.en: This Sentient war instrument can either barrage targets with explosive bolts or draw on its regenerative battery to create twin plasma beams that chain through targets. When fully drained, Health is leeched from nearby foes for a short period.
descriptions.zh: （英文：BASMU）这种 Sentient 军械可以用爆炸投射物密集轰击目标，也可以利用其可再生电池制造出两股将多个目标束缚在一起的等离子光束。当电量完全耗尽时，会在短时间内吸取附近敌人的生命值。

descriptions.en: Fires volleys of icy grenades that inflict a lingering chill on the blast zone.
descriptions.zh: （英文：CRYOTRA）发射一连串冰冷的手榴弹，在爆炸区域留下持久的寒气。

descriptions.en: Releases a burst of static electricity that can jump between foes, incapacitating them.
descriptions.zh: （英文：TAZICOR）释放出一阵静电，该静电可以在敌人之间跳跃，使他们失去战斗能力。

descriptions.en: Charges up a powerful blast of ultra-heated plasma.
descriptions.zh: （英文：VULCAX）可蓄能发射出强力爆发的极热电浆。

descriptions.en: This arm-cannon, ripped from a Sentient, rapid-fires thermal pulses that explode in an electrical blast. Features an ammo-less quick charge capacitor, that emits a knock-back pulse and strips Sentient damage resistances when fully discharged.
descriptions.zh: （英文：SHEDU）这种从 Sentient 身上扯下来的手炮能快速射出热脉冲，并在电击中爆炸。它有一个不需要弹药的快充电容器，在完全放电时会发出回弹脉冲并解除 Sentient 的伤害抗性。

descriptions.en: The Sicarus Prime is an ornamental firearm that fires rounds in rapid bursts, providing a balance between the lethality of auto-pistols and the accuracy of semi-automatic pistols.
descriptions.zh: （英文：SICARUS PRIME）暗杀者 PRIME 是一把快速点射的装饰性武器，在连发手枪的杀伤力和单发手枪的准确度之间取得平衡。

descriptions.en: A perfectly crafted pairing, this mace and shield combination is sculpted for exhibition but balanced for the battlefield.
descriptions.zh: （英文：SILVA & AEGIS PRIME）完美打造的一对，权杖与盾的组合不仅是为了展示而雕凿，也权衡了战场的用途。

descriptions.en: The Kama is a Tenno style hatchet, capable of making short work of any foe.
descriptions.zh: （英文：KAMA）短柄战镰是一个 Tenno 风格的短柄斧，能够迅速击杀任何敌人。

descriptions.en: A lone Tenno once used this staff to fight back a horde of Infested.
